Four Went Ways Services on the A11 is 18.8 km off and Caxton Gibbet Services on the A428 is 20.5 km. A station 18.6 km from the town is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That mapping is incomplete, so it is one example rather than a full picture.

name: Royston
intro: Since 1974 Royston has been part of the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley; before that the village was in the West Riding. It now sits on the border with West Yorkshire, 4 miles (6.4 km) north-east of Barnsley and 6 miles (9.7 km) south-east of Wakefield, and has a population of 10,728. Postcodes fall in S71. Cudworth and Shafton is about 3 km away, Darton 4.3 km and Barnsley 4.5 km, with Wombwell at 9.1 km and Wakefield 10 km. For an AdBlue warning, Woolley Edge Services on the M1 is the nearest listed service area at about 6.7 km in a straight line, and a station in Pontefract listed as selling AdBlue at the pump is about 9.3 km away.
roadsText: Woolley Edge Services on the M1 is the nearest service area to Royston, about 6.7 km in a straight line, followed by Exelby Services Whitwood on the M62 (13.1 km) and Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 (14.6 km). OpenStreetMap lists a station in Pontefract (WF7 7HX), about 9.3 km away, and another in Leeds (LS9 0AS), about 19.5 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. Coverage is incomplete.

name: Royton
intro: Royton was the first town where a powered cotton mill was built, at Thorp in 1764. Today it is a town in the Metropolitan Borough of Oldham, close to the source of the River Irk and near undulating land at the foothills of the South Pennines. It lies 3.2 km north-west of Oldham, 4.8 km south-east of Rochdale and 12.9 km north-east of Manchester, and had 21,284 residents in 2011. The town spans the OL1 and OL2 postcode districts. Its neighbours are all close by: Shaw is 2.5 km away, Oldham 3.4 km, Chadderton 4.3 km, Middleton 5 km, Lees 5.2 km and Rochdale 5.8 km. Many journeys from Royton are short trips between these towns, and the nearest motorway service area, Birch on the M62, is 7 km away.
roadsText: Royton's closest service area is Birch on the M62, 7 km away. The others are much further: Blackburn with Darwen on the M65 at 28.3 km and Hartshead Moor on the M62 at 29.8 km. Two stations, one 5.6 km away and one in Manchester at 11.3 km, are listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete, so other forecourts may stock it.

name: Rugby
intro: No town in the West Midlands region lies further east than Rugby, which sits on the eastern edge of Warwickshire close to the borders with Leicestershire and Northamptonshire. It lies near the River Avon, 11.5 miles (18.5km) east of Coventry and 30 miles east-south-east of Birmingham, and had 78,117 residents at the 2021 census. Postcodes are CV21, CV22 and CV23. Three motorways appear on the local road list, the M6, M45 and M1, along with the A428, A426, A4071, A5 and A45. Lutterworth is about 9.3km away and Daventry 13.7km. For a van or diesel car, a day here can include short local runs and long motorway journeys, and an AdBlue warning can show up on either. The nearest motorway services are only about 3.8km from the town.
roadsText: Two stops sit within about 4km of Rugby: Rugby services on the M6 at 3.8km and a truck stop on the A5 at 4km. Watford Gap services on the M1 is 11.5km away. The listed roads are the M6, M45, M1, A428, A426, A4071, A5 and A45. OpenStreetMap lists one forecourt, about 14.2km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump, but that data is incomplete and other sites in CV21, CV22 or CV23 may sell it too.

name: Rugeley
intro: Beside the River Trent, on the north-eastern edge of Cannock Chase, Rugeley is a market town in the Cannock Chase District of Staffordshire. It is 8 miles (13 km) north of Lichfield, 10 miles (16 km) south-east of Stafford, 5 miles (8 km) north-east of Hednesford and 11 miles (18 km) south-west of Uttoxeter, and had 26,156 residents at the 2021 Census. The main roads listed around the town are the A460, A513 and A51, and none of them is a motorway. That matters if an AdBlue warning appears, because the nearest motorway service area is more than 10 km away. Cannock, at 8.3 km measured directly, and Burntwood, at 9.1 km, are the closest towns, with Lichfield at 11.7 km and Stafford at 11.9 km. The town falls within the WS15 postcode district.
roadsText: The A460, A513 and A51 are the main roads listed around Rugeley; there is no motorway among them. The nearest service areas, measured directly, are Norton Canes on the M6 Toll (10.8 km), The Trucker's Rest on the A5 (12.1 km) and Hilton Park on the M6 (15.1 km). OpenStreetMap lists a station with a Burntwood address, 9 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. That record is not a complete picture.

name: Runcorn
intro: Runcorn stands on the south bank of the River Mersey, where the estuary narrows to form the Runcorn Gap. It is an industrial town and cargo port in the Borough of Halton, Cheshire, about 15 miles south-east of Liverpool and 29 miles south-west of Manchester, and part of the Liverpool City Region. The 1776 extension of the Bridgewater Canal made it a port linking coastal Liverpool with inland Manchester and Staffordshire. The built-up area had 61,145 people at the 2021 census, and WA7 is the postcode district listed for it. The M56 is the motorway on the road list, with the A533, A5126, A56, A557, A562, A558 and A5080. Widnes is the nearest town at 5.6 km, with Warrington at 9.5 km, Prescot at 11.9 km, Northwich at 13.3 km, St Helens at 13.6 km and Newton-le-Willows at 14.2 km.
roadsText: Runcorn's main roads are the M56, A533, A5126, A56, A557, A562, A558 and A5080. Whitley Services on the A49 is the nearest service area at 7.5 km, with Chester Services on the M56 and Burtonwood Services on the M62 both 10.3 km away. In OpenStreetMap, which may not show every site, two stations in Warrington, in WA5 (9.2 km) and WA3 (14.6 km), are listed as selling AdBlue at the pump.

name: Rushall and Shelfield
intro: Centred on the main road between Walsall and Lichfield, Rushall is a historic village in the Metropolitan Borough of Walsall. It is mentioned in the Domesday Book but has mostly developed since the 1920s, and it was part of Staffordshire until it was incorporated, with much of the old Aldridge-Brownhills Urban District, into the modern Walsall district. Together with Shelfield it is covered by the WS4 and WS9 postcode districts. Neighbouring places are close: Aldridge is 2.1 km away, Pelsall 2.6 km, Bloxwich 3 km, Walsall 3.8 km and Brownhills 4.2 km, with Streetly at 5.6 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service area is on the M6 Toll, 6.1 km off in a straight line, and the M6 has another at 7.8 km.
roadsText: The nearest service areas to Rushall and Shelfield are Norton Canes Services on the M6 Toll, 6.1 km away in a straight line, Hilton Park Services on the M6 at 7.8 km and The Trucker's Rest on the A5 at 10.9 km. OpenStreetMap lists stations in Burntwood (WS7 3XA, 7.8 km) and Warley (12.9 km) as selling AdBlue at the pump, plus an HGV-only site in Birmingham (B25 8DW, 18.3 km) for lorries. Its coverage is incomplete.

name: Rushden
intro: Fifth largest town in Northamptonshire, with a population of 32,038, Rushden sits on the county's border with Bedfordshire, around 18 miles (29 km) east of Northampton and 12 miles (19 km) north of Bedford. The wider urban area, which includes the adjoining town of Higham Ferrers, has 40,865 people. The postcode district is NN10. Main roads include the A6 and A45, together with the A509, A510, A5001, A5028, A5128 and A5193. Raunds is about 7.2 km away and Wellingborough 7.3 km, with Burton Latimer at 10.2 km and Bedford around 19.1 km. The nearest service area is Thrapston Services on the A45, about 12.5 km away, and the next two are more than 20 km out, so a driver with an AdBlue warning around Rushden has limited choice close by.
roadsText: Rushden's main roads are the A6, A45, A509, A510, A5001, A5028, A5128 and A5193. Thrapston Services on the A45 is the nearest service area at about 12.5 km. Rothwell Truck Stop on the A14 is around 20.1 km away, and Bedford Services on the A421 about 21.9 km.

name: Rustington
intro: Roughly halfway along the West Sussex coast, between Chichester and Brighton, Rustington is a village and civil parish in the Arun District. It forms part of the Brighton and Hove built-up area, and its postcode districts are BN16 and BN12. The A259 runs along the north of the village, heading west to Littlehampton, Bognor Regis and Chichester and east to Worthing and Brighton. The A27, A280, A284 and A2032 are also listed. Littlehampton is only 3.9km away, Wick 4.6km and Worthing 5.6km, so neighbouring places are close. With no motorway on the road list and the nearest service area 12.6km away, a driver here is likely to spend most of their time on A roads.
roadsText: Around Rustington, the listed main roads are the A280, A27, A259, A2032 and A284. The nearest service area is Fontwell Services on the A27, 12.6km away. Buck Barn on the A24 is 21.5km and Pyecombe Services on the A23 is 23.3km. Fontwell is by some way the closest of the three.

name: Rutherglen
intro: Immediately southeast of Glasgow and directly south of the River Clyde, Rutherglen is a South Lanarkshire town about five kilometres from the city. It was once a separate Lanarkshire burgh, became part of the City of Glasgow District in 1975 along with neighbouring Cambuslang, and was reallocated to the South Lanarkshire council area in 1996. Its population is listed at 30,950. Postcode districts linked to the town are G73, G45, G44, G40 and G42. The road list includes four motorways, the M74, M8, M80 and M77, plus the A725, A726, A730 and A749, and the nearest motorway service area is 9.2 km away. Cambuslang is 3.4 km away, Giffnock 5.6 km and East Kilbride 6.8 km, with Blantyre at 7.5 km and Newton Mearns at 8.9 km.
roadsText: Main roads recorded around Rutherglen are the M74, M8, M80, M77, A726, A725, A749 and A730. Bothwell Services on the M74 is the nearest service area at 9.2 km, with Hamilton Services on the M74 at 11.4 km and the M74 Truck Stop at 27.4 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Glasgow (G11 6DN), 8.5 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. That map data is not complete.

name: Ryde
intro: Growth as a seaside resort came to Ryde after the villages of Upper Ryde and Lower Ryde were merged in the 19th century. The town and civil parish is on the north-east coast of the Isle of Wight, and its parish area had 24,096 residents at the 2021 Census. Its wide sands are exposed at low tide, which is why the regular ferry service to the mainland needs a long pier, the fourth longest in the United Kingdom and the oldest surviving. The town is in the PO33 postcode district, and the main roads listed around it are the A3054 and A3055. Sandown is 8.1 km away and Newport 10 km, with Cowes at 11.2 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the island setting matters, because the straight-line distances to the nearest listed service areas take no account of the ferry crossing.
roadsText: The main roads listed around Ryde are the A3054 and A3055. The nearest listed service areas are Farlington Services on the A27 at 15.2 km, Rownhams Services on the M27 at 33 km and Petersfield Services on the A3 at 35.1 km. Because Ryde is on the Isle of Wight, linked to the mainland by ferry, these straight-line distances do not reflect the real journey.

name: Saffron Walden
intro: With its rural appearance and some buildings from the medieval period, Saffron Walden is a market town in the Uttlesford district of Essex, 15 miles (24 km) south of Cambridge and 12 miles (19 km) north of Bishop's Stortford. London is 43 miles (69 km) away. The parish also takes in Little Walden and Audley End, and the built-up area had 16,610 residents at the 2021 census. Two postcode districts, CB10 and CB11, cover the area. Other towns are some distance off: Haverhill is 15.2 km away, Bishop's Stortford 17.7 km and Great Dunmow 17.8 km. If a van or diesel car flags an AdBlue problem, Four Went Ways Services on the A11 is the nearest listed service area at 12 km in a straight line, with the M11 site at Birchanger Green 16.9 km away.
roadsText: Four Went Ways Services on the A11 is 12 km from Saffron Walden in a straight line, making it the closest service area. Birchanger Green Services on the M11 is 16.9 km away and Baldock Services on the A1(M) is 30.7 km. A station in Bishop's Stortford (CM23 3LA), 18.6 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. The map data is incomplete, so other forecourts may sell it too.

name: Sale
intro: Sitting on the south bank of the River Mersey, Sale is a Trafford town 5 miles south-west of Manchester, 2 miles south of Stretford and 3 miles north-east of Altrincham. It lies within the historic county boundaries of Cheshire and became part of Greater Manchester in 1974. The Bridgewater Canal reached the town in 1765 and drove its growth, and the built-up area had 62,550 people at the 2021 census. Postcode districts M21, M23, M32 and M33 are listed. The road list includes the M60 and M56, along with the A56, A5181, A560, A5145, A6010 and A5103. Stretford (3.3 km) and Altrincham (3.5 km) are the nearest towns, with Wythenshawe at 4.3 km, Urmston at 4.6 km, Old Trafford at 4.9 km and Hale at 6.9 km. The three nearest service areas in the data are all on the M6, roughly 14 km away.
roadsText: Sale's main roads include the M60 and M56, with the A56, A5181, A560, A5145, A6010 and A5103. The nearest service areas are all on the M6: Tabley Hill at 13.9 km, Lymm at 14 km and Knutsford at 14.4 km. Stations listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap include one in Manchester's M25 postcode district (13.1 km), one in Warrington's WA3 (13.6 km) and one about 16 km away. Its coverage is incomplete.

name: Salford
intro: Salford faces Manchester city centre across the River Irwell, which forms the boundary between the two cities. In 2021 it had 129,794 people, and it is the main settlement of the wider City of Salford metropolitan borough, which also takes in Eccles, Pendlebury, Swinton and Walkden. Salford Docks opened in 1894 and made the city a major inland port. The postcode districts in the data are M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M15, M17 and M50. Three motorway-standard roads appear on the road list, the M602, M60 and A57(M), with the A576, A6, A5063, A57 and A580 alongside them. Old Trafford (3.4 km), Clifton (3.8 km) and Prestwich (4.2 km) are the nearest places, followed by Swinton (4.6 km), Stretford (4.9 km) and Eccles (5.2 km). For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the closest listed service area is 9.2 km away on the M62.
roadsText: Around Salford the main roads are the M602, M60 and A57(M), plus the A576, A6, A5063, A57 and A580. Birch Services on the M62 is the closest service area at 9.2 km; Lymm (20.7 km) and Tabley Hill (22 km) are both on the M6. Stations listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap include one in Manchester's M25 postcode district (5.1 km), one about 9.8 km away and one in Warrington's WA3 (17.9 km). It does not record every site.

name: Salisbury
intro: Near the edge of Salisbury Plain, in the south-east of Wiltshire, Salisbury is a cathedral city at the meeting of the rivers Avon, Nadder and Bourne. It is about 30 km from Southampton and 50 km from Bath, and the civil parish has a population of 41,820. The city grew up around a new cathedral built near the rivers, after an earlier cathedral at Old Sarum to the north, and it received a city charter in 1227 as New Sarum. Stonehenge is 13 km to the north-west. The SP1 and SP2 postcode districts cover the city. Seven A roads are listed around it, and the nearest towns are spread out: Amesbury is 9.8 km away, Tidworth 20 km, Verwood 22.5 km and Romsey 24.2 km. For a van or diesel car, that means longer runs between towns are a normal part of driving here.
roadsText: Salisbury's main roads are the A36, A30, A338, A354, A345, A360 and A3094, and there is no motorway among them. The nearest service areas are Rufus Stone on the A31, 22.4 km away, West Wellow on the A36 at 22.7 km and Weyhill on the A303 at 24.1 km. All three are more than 22 km out, so it is worth dealing with a warning before a long trip.

name: Saltash
intro: Known as the Gateway to Cornwall, Saltash faces the city of Plymouth across the River Tamar in the east of the county. The Tamar Bridge, which connects Plymouth to Cornwall by road, is one of its landmarks, alongside the Royal Albert Bridge, so the town sits at a key road crossing into Cornwall. The built-up area had 15,435 people at the 2021 census, and the town is in the PL12 postcode district. Plymouth is 7.2 km away, Tavistock 16.2 km and Liskeard 17.5 km. Saltash Services on the A388 is only 1.3 km away in a straight line, which helps if an AdBlue warning appears. The next listed option, Cornwall Services on the A30, is 41.9 km away, so the A388 site is the one to remember.
roadsText: Saltash Services on the A388 is the nearest listed service area, just 1.3 km from Saltash in a straight line. The next two are much further away: Cornwall Services on the A30 at 41.9 km and Exeter Services on the M5 at 63.6 km. For drivers in PL12 with an AdBlue warning, the A388 site is by far the closest option.

name: Saltcoats
intro: Saltcoats takes its name from its earliest industry, when salt was harvested from the sea water of the Firth of Clyde in small cottages along the shore. The town is on the west coast of North Ayrshire and is the third largest in the council area, with about 12,250 residents. It forms the 'Three Towns' conurbation with Stevenston and with Ardrossan, which is just 1.6 km away, and its addresses fall across the KA21, KA22 and KA20 postcode districts. Kilwinning (5.1 km) and Irvine (8.6 km) are the next nearest towns, with Troon at 13.3 km, Largs at 17.8 km and Kilmarnock at 18.5 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the key point is how far away the motorway services are: the nearest listed ones are on the M74, close to 50 km away in a straight line.
roadsText: Saltcoats is a long way from any listed motorway service area. The three nearest are all on the M74: Bothwell Services at 49.1 km, Hamilton Services at 49.6 km and the M74 Truck Stop at 56 km, all measured as straight-line distances from the town centre. On the road the trip will be longer, so a low AdBlue warning is better dealt with before setting off on a longer run.

name: Sandbach
intro: Four settlements make up the civil parish of Sandbach: Sandbach itself, Elworth, Ettiley Heath and Wheelock. The market town is in Cheshire East, and at the 2021 census its built-up area had 11,290 residents and the parish 21,916. Its postcode district is CW11. The nearest towns are a few kilometres apart: Alsager is 7 km away, Middlewich 7.1 km and Crewe 7.8 km, with Kidsgrove and Congleton both just over 10 km. For drivers, the M6 is the road to know, because Sandbach Services is just 2 km from the town and Crewe Services, also on the M6, is 8.4 km off. That puts a motorway stop within easy reach if an AdBlue warning comes on.
roadsText: Sandbach Services on the M6 is 2 km from the town, Crewe Services on the M6 is 8.4 km and Keele Services, also on the M6, is 17.4 km away. Crewe itself is 7.8 km away and Middlewich 7.1 km, with Winsford at 11.8 km. All three of the nearest service areas are on the M6.

name: Sandhurst
intro: Known worldwide as the home of the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst, this town and civil parish sits in the south-eastern corner of Berkshire, in the Bracknell Forest borough, about 32 miles west-south-west of London. It also has a large out-of-town commercial development called The Meadows. The town has about 20,220 residents across the GU47 and GU17 postcode districts. Neighbouring places are close together here: Crowthorne is 2.9 km away, Camberley and Yateley 3.9 km and Frimley 4.9 km, with Wokingham and Bracknell both 6.9 km off. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed motorway services are Fleet Services on the M3, 7.9 km away in a straight line, and a station at Reading is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Fleet Services on the M3 is the nearest listed service area to Sandhurst at 7.9 km. Reading Services on the M4 is 19.5 km away and Wisley Services on the A3 is 21.2 km, all in a straight line. A station in Reading (RG7 1LZ), 15.1 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump; that source is incomplete.

name: Sandown
intro: Sandown is a seaside resort town and civil parish on the south-east coast of the Isle of Wight, and the northernmost of the three Sandown Bay settlements. Lake and the neighbouring resort of Shanklin sit just to the south, and together the three form a built-up area of more than 20,000 people, though Sandown itself had 7,125 residents at the 2021 census. Its sandy beaches run from the cliffs below Battery Gardens in the south to Yaverland in the north. The town is covered by the PO36 and PO37 postcode districts. Ryde is 8.1 km away, Newport 10.5 km and Cowes 14.9 km. If an AdBlue warning comes on, the location matters: the nearest listed service area is Farlington Services on the A27, 22.7 km away in a straight line, so a services stop is not a quick option from Sandown.
roadsText: From Sandown, the nearest listed service areas are Farlington Services on the A27, 22.7 km away in a straight line, Rownhams Services on the M27 at 39.3 km and West Wellow Services on the A36 at 42.4 km. None of them is close to PO36 or PO37, and road distances will be longer than these straight-line figures, so an AdBlue warning here is best dealt with promptly rather than left for a services stop.

name: Sandy
intro: The A1 skirts the western edge of Sandy, a Central Bedfordshire town that sits between a low range of sandy hills to the east and the River Ivel to the west. Those hills, part of the Bedfordshire Greensand Ridge, give the town its name. Sandy lies 8 miles (13 km) east of Bedford and 18 miles (29 km) south-west of Cambridge, and the parish includes the hamlet of Beeston, which straddles the A1 to the south-west. The town had 12,171 residents at the 2021 census and is covered by the SG19 postcode district. Biggleswade is 6.5 km away and St Neots 9.8 km. For an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service areas are Bedford Services on the A421 at 13.1 km and Baldock Services on the A1(M) at 14.9 km, both in a straight line.
roadsText: The A1 runs along the western edge of Sandy. The nearest service areas are Bedford Services on the A421, 13.1 km away in a straight line, Baldock Services on the A1(M) at 14.9 km and Caxton Gibbet Services on the A428 at 16.5 km. All three are within about 17 km of SG19, so there are three options within a similar range.

name: Sarn
intro: About three miles (five kilometres) north of Bridgend, Sarn is a village and electoral ward in Bridgend County Borough, lying just east of where the Ogmore and Llynfi rivers meet. Aberkenfig is to the west, Brynmenyn to the north and Tondu to the north-west. The M4 is around 15 minutes' walk away. The village is in the CF32 postcode district. Pyle is 6.8 km away, Maesteg 8.6 km and Porthcawl 9.9 km, with Tonyrefail and Tonypandy a little further at 11.5 km and 12.6 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the standout fact is the motorway services: Sarn Park Services on the M4 is just 1.3 km away in a straight line, which gives a driver a nearby place to pull in. The next listed site is much further, at 19.8 km.
roadsText: Sarn Park Services on the M4 is the nearest service area to Sarn, just 1.3 km away in a straight line, and the M4 itself is around 15 minutes' walk from the village. The next nearest are on the M4 too: Cardiff West Services at 19.8 km and Cardiff Gate Services at 31.7 km. Road distances will be longer than these figures, but Sarn Park is close at hand if an AdBlue warning comes on.

name: Sawbridgeworth
intro: On the west bank of the River Stort, where the river marks the county boundary with Essex, Sawbridgeworth is a town and civil parish in East Hertfordshire. It sits between Bishop's Stortford to the north and Harlow to the south, 16 km east of the county town of Hertford. The parish reaches into the surrounding countryside to the north and south, taking in the hamlet of Spellbrook, while the built-up area extends beyond the parish boundary to include Lower Sheering and had 10,475 people at the 2021 census. The postcode district is CM21. Harlow is 5.2 km away and Bishop's Stortford 6.6 km, so a good share of local driving runs between the two, with Ware and Hoddesdon both 12.3 km off and Epping 13.2 km. Journeys here mix the town itself with the rural parts of the parish.
roadsText: Birchanger Green on the M11 is the closest service area, 7.4 km from Sawbridgeworth. The next nearest are much further: Boreham on the A131 at 26.2 km and South Mimms on the A1(M) at 28.9 km. A station at Thorley in Bishop's Stortford, 5.7 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. OpenStreetMap data is incomplete, so other forecourts nearby may sell it as well.

name: Scarborough
intro: The older part of Scarborough lies around its harbour, protected by a rocky headland that extends into the North Sea, and from there the town rises steeply north and west towards limestone cliffs, between 3 and 70 metres above sea level. With 61,749 people, this North Yorkshire seaside town is the largest on the Yorkshire Coast. The bigger issue for anyone with an AdBlue warning is distance. The nearest towns are Bridlington at 22.8 km in a straight line, Driffield at 28 km and Whitby at 28.3 km, and the three closest service areas are all more than 61 km away. The main roads listed are the A64, A165, A171 and A170, none of them a motorway. The town's postcode districts are YO11 and YO12. Fishing and service industries are part of the local economy, and the town is also a tourist destination.
roadsText: Main roads around Scarborough are the A64, A165, A171 and A170. Service areas are a long way off: Teesside Truck Stop on the A66 is 61.4 km away in a straight line, a service area on the A19 is 61.7 km and Bilbrough Top Service Area on the A64 is 64.2 km. With distances like these, an AdBlue warning is best dealt with before setting out on a longer run.

name: Scawthorpe and Cusworth
intro: Split between the Roman Ridge and Bentley wards of Doncaster's city council, Scawthorpe is a suburb of Doncaster on the A638 road in South Yorkshire. Covered here together with Cusworth, the area has 13,020 residents and falls in the DN5 postcode district. Neighbours are very close: Bentley is 1.7 km away, Adwick le Street 3.8 km and Doncaster 5.3 km, with Warmsworth, Kirk Sandall and Edenthorpe, and Conisbrough all between 6.9 km and 7.6 km off. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest service areas are a little further out. Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 is 10.4 km from the centre in a straight line, and Doncaster (North) Services on the M180 is 13.2 km. Closer in, a station in Doncaster, 4.6 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Scawthorpe sits on the A638. The nearest service areas are Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1, 10.4 km away in a straight line, Doncaster (North) Services on the M180 at 13.2 km and Ferrybridge Services on the M62 at 18.4 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Doncaster (DN4 0TP), 4.6 km away, and one in Pontefract (WF7 7HX), 15.7 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. The map data is incomplete.

name: Scunthorpe
intro: Lincolnshire's third most populous settlement, after Lincoln and Grimsby, Scunthorpe is an industrial town of 81,286 people (2021) and the administrative centre of North Lincolnshire. It lies north of Lincoln, between Grimsby to the east and Doncaster to the west, with Hull to the north-east by way of the Humber Bridge. For drivers, the motorway links are the notable thing: the M180, M181 and A1077(M) are all listed among the main roads, together with the A18, A159, A1029 and A1077. Even so, the nearest other towns are some distance away. Brough is 17.1 km away as the crow flies, Barton-upon-Humber 18 km and Goole 20.5 km. Postcode districts are DN15, DN16 and DN17. If an AdBlue warning comes on, it helps to know that each of the three nearest service areas is more than 20 km away.
roadsText: The M180, M181 and A1077(M) are the motorways among Scunthorpe's main routes, with the A18, A159, A1029 and A1077 also listed. Service areas are further off than those motorway links might suggest. As the crow flies, Doncaster North services on the M180 is 22.7 km away, Ulceby Truckstop on the A160 is 24.6 km and Showground Services on the A15 is 33.1 km.

name: Seaford
intro: Between Newhaven to the west and Eastbourne to the east, Seaford is an East Sussex town that was one of the main ports serving southern England in the Middle Ages, until coastal sedimentation silted up its harbour. Its fortunes revived in the 19th century when the railway linked it to Lewes and London, and it became a small seaside resort. More recently it has become a dormitory town for Eastbourne, Brighton and London. The town has about 23,865 residents and is in the BN25 postcode district. Newhaven is 4.9 km away and Peacehaven 7.9 km, with Polegate at 10.5 km and Eastbourne at 12.1 km. The main roads listed around Seaford are the A26 and A259. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service area is Polegate Services on the A22, 10.4 km away in a straight line.
roadsText: The main roads listed around Seaford are the A26 and A259. Polegate Services on the A22 is the nearest listed service area at 10.4 km, followed by Pyecombe Services on the A23 at 24.3 km and Ricebridge Services (Hickstead), also on the A23, at 30.2 km. A station 18.1 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump; that data is not complete. All distances are straight-line.

name: Seaham
intro: A seaside town on the Durham Coast, Seaham lies 10 km south of Sunderland and 21 km east of Durham. It grew from the late 19th century onwards on the back of investment in its harbour and coal mines, and today it has a population of 21,660 within the SR7 postcode district. The town's neighbours are mostly a few kilometres away rather than right next door: Houghton-le-Spring is 7.9 km, Sunderland 8.4 km and Peterlee 8.5 km, with Shiney Row and Penshaw at 9.2 km, Washington at 13 km and Chester-le-Street at 14.7 km. For a driver, the A19 is the nearest main route to keep in mind, as Easington services on that road is only 3.7 km from the town. Reaching the nearest A1(M) services means a drive of 14.5 km or more.
roadsText: Easington services on the A19 is the closest stop to Seaham, just 3.7 km away. The two nearest A1(M) service areas are further off, with Washington at 14.5 km and Durham at 16.3 km. A station with a Durham postcode (DH6 3LJ), 11.6 km from the town, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. The map data is incomplete, so other forecourts may sell it too.

name: Sedgley
intro: Sitting on the A459 between Wolverhampton and Dudley, Sedgley is a town in the north of the Dudley district of the West Midlands. It was historically part of Staffordshire and was once the seat of an ancient manor that took in Gornal, Gospel End, Woodsetton, Ettingshall, Coseley and Bradley. Most of it was absorbed into an expanded County Borough of Dudley in 1966, and it has been part of the Metropolitan Borough of Dudley since 1974. With a van or car showing an AdBlue fault, the practical picture is a town with close neighbours: Coseley is 2.5 km away as the crow flies, Dudley 3.5 km, Kingswinford 4 km and Wombourne 4.8 km. The DY3, DY1 and DY6 postcode districts cover the area. Main roads nearby include the A463, A4123 and A449 alongside the A459 itself, and none of the roads listed is a motorway.
roadsText: No motorway features among the main roads around Sedgley; the A463, A4123, A461, A4036, A449, A491, A41 and A4150 are listed, along with the A459 the town stands on. Frankley on the M5 is the nearest service area at 13.2 km as the crow flies, with Hilton Park on the M6 at 13.9 km and The Trucker's Rest on the A5 at 17.7 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station with a Warley address, 6.8 km away, and another 19 km away as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete.

name: Selby
intro: Twelve miles (19.3 km) south of York on the River Ouse, Selby is a market town and civil parish in North Yorkshire with 17,193 residents at the 2021 census. It grew around Selby Abbey and was once an important port on the Selby Canal, which brought trade from Leeds, as well as a centre for shipbuilding and mining. The town was part of the West Riding until 1974, served as the administrative centre of Selby District until 2023, and now falls under North Yorkshire Council. Its postcode district is YO8. Goole is about 15.1 km away, while Pontefract, Castleford and York are all within 20 km. Drivers here with an AdBlue warning have two service areas at almost exactly the same straight-line distance: Ferrybridge Services on the M62 and Bilbrough Top on the A64, both about 15.9 km from the town centre.
roadsText: Two service areas sit at about the same straight-line distance from Selby: Ferrybridge Services on the M62 and Bilbrough Top Service Area on the A64, each roughly 15.9 km away. Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 is next at about 20.4 km. Which of the two closest makes more sense will depend on your direction of travel, and actual road distances will be longer than these figures.

name: Selsey
intro: Only one road, the B2145, runs in and out of Selsey, crossing a bridge over the inlet at Pagham Harbour at a spot known as the ferry. That single route shapes every journey here. The seaside town sits at the southernmost point of the Manhood Peninsula, about eight miles (13 km) south of Chichester, and is almost cut off from mainland Sussex by the sea, with Bracklesham Bay to the west, Pagham Harbour to the east and Selsey Bill at its southern tip. The parish had 10,737 residents in 2011 and is covered by the PO20 postcode district. Bognor Regis is 9.8 km away and Chichester 11.8 km. With an AdBlue warning on the dashboard, every trip out starts on the B2145, and the nearest listed service area, Fontwell Services on the A27, is 16.7 km away in a straight line.
roadsText: Every journey out of Selsey begins on the B2145, the town's only road in and out. The two nearest listed service areas are both on the A27: Fontwell Services at 16.7 km in a straight line and Farlington Services at 20.9 km. Petersfield Services on the A3 is further at 32.6 km. From the tip of a peninsula, road distances to all three will be longer than these figures.

name: Sevenoaks
intro: About 34 km south-east of Charing Cross, Sevenoaks is the principal town of its Kent district, ahead of Swanley and Edenbridge. The built-up area had a population of 26,475 at the 2021 census, and the town has a large commuting population, served by the South Eastern Main Line into London. It became part of the modern communications network in the 18th century, when one of the early turnpikes was opened. Today the TN13 and TN14 postcode districts cover the town, with Knole Park to the south-east. For a van or diesel car, regular journeys often mean runs to Tonbridge, 11.4 km away, Swanley at 13.4 km or Oxted at 13.5 km, while Bromley and Royal Tunbridge Wells are 15 km and 17.1 km away. With the M25 and M26 both among the roads around the town, a warning light can just as easily appear on a motorway leg as on a local street.
roadsText: Around Sevenoaks the main roads are the M25 and M26, plus the A25, A21, A224 and A225. The nearest service area is Clacket Lane on the M25, 10.2 km away, followed by Tollgate on the A2 at 19.7 km and Thurrock on the M25 at 24.5 km. One station 19.8 km from the town is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap data. That map data is incomplete, so other forecourts may well stock it too.

name: Shaw
intro: Around 9 miles from Manchester city centre, Shaw is a ward and part of the built-up area of Shaw and Crompton, a civil parish in the Oldham district of Greater Manchester. The built-up area had 18,245 residents in 2021, and the Shaw ward alone had 10,045. Until 1974 it was in Lancashire. The OL2 postcode district covers the town. Royton is the closest neighbour at about 2.5 km, followed by Oldham at 4.6 km, Lees at 5.1 km and Rochdale at 5.8 km. Chadderton is around 6.6 km away and Uppermill 6.9 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest motorway service area is Birch Services on the M62, about 9.1 km off, while the next nearest service areas are much further away, at more than 27 km.
roadsText: Birch Services on the M62 is the nearest service area to Shaw, about 9.1 km away. Hartshead Moor services, also on the M62, is around 27.4 km off, and Hollin Bank Service Station on the M65 roughly 29.1 km. OpenStreetMap has a site about 7.7 km away listed as selling AdBlue at the pump, plus one under Manchester at around 13.6 km. OpenStreetMap is not a complete record, so others may be closer.

name: Sheerness
intro: At the mouth of the River Medway, on the north-west corner of the Isle of Sheppey, Sheerness is a port town and civil parish in north Kent with a population of 13,249. It is the second largest town on the island after Minster, 3.7 km away, and its postcode district is ME12. Sheerness began as a 16th-century fort, became the site of a Royal Navy dockyard in 1669, and later added a pier and promenade as a seaside resort. Today the Port of Sheerness is one of the United Kingdom's leading car and fresh produce importers. From the island, the nearest listed service area, Medway Services on the M2, is 14.7 km away in a straight line. Sittingbourne is 10 km off and Gillingham 14.4 km, so an AdBlue warning here calls for some planning.
roadsText: From Sheerness, Medway Services on the M2 is the nearest listed service area at 14.7 km in a straight line. Maidstone Services on the M20 is 21.2 km away and Orsett Cock Services on the A13 is 26.1 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station at Temple Farm, Strood (ME2 2NY), 19.8 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. The listing is incomplete, so there may be closer stations that sell it.

name: Sheffield
intro: Second largest city in Yorkshire, Sheffield lies in the eastern foothills of the Pennines, in the valley of the River Don and its tributaries the Loxley, Porter Brook, Rivelin and Sheaf. It is 29 miles (47 km) south of Leeds and 32 miles (51 km) east of Manchester, and the wider metropolitan borough had an estimated 579,517 residents in 2025. Its cutlery trade expanded hugely in the 19th century; much later, its iron and steel industries declined in the 1970s and 1980s. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue fault, the M1 is the motorway among the main roads listed, together with the A61, A621, A57, A6102, A630, A631 and A6135. Postcode districts include S1, S2, S3, S4, S7, S10, S11 and S14. Neighbouring places are not far: Dronfield is 7.9 km away in a straight line, Rotherham 9.6 km and Chapeltown and High Green 10.1 km.
roadsText: The M1 is the motorway among the main roads around Sheffield, with the A61, A621, A57, A6102, A630, A631 and A6135 also listed. The closest service area is Sheffield Service Area on the A6102, about 3 km from the centre in a straight line. Rotherham Services on the M1 is 7.7 km away and Woodall services on the M1 is 13.5 km. Straight-line figures understate the distance by road.

name: Shepshed
intro: Often known until 1888 as Sheepshed, a name tied to its heavy involvement in the wool industry, Shepshed is a market town in Leicestershire's Charnwood borough and the second largest settlement there after Loughborough. It had 14,875 residents at the 2021 census and its postcode district is LE12. Loughborough is just 4.6 km away, with Whitwick at 5.1 km and Coalville at 6.6 km. Mountsorrel is 11.1 km off, Ashby-de-la-Zouch 12.1 km and Long Eaton 14.2 km. For drivers, the M1 is close by: Moto Donington Park Services is 6.4 km from the town, which gives a nearby place to stop if an AdBlue warning appears on a van or diesel car. Two more service areas, on the A50 and the A6, are within 14 km.
roadsText: Moto Donington Park Services on the M1 is the nearest service area to Shepshed, 6.4 km away. Welcome Break Derby South Services on the A50 is 12.6 km away and ExtraMSA Leicester Services on the A6 is 13.9 km away. A station in Swadlincote (DE12 8AA), 19.1 km away, is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump; the map does not capture every station, so nearer ones may sell it too.

name: Sherborne
intro: The A30, the road connecting London with Penzance, runs through Sherborne, a market town in north-west Dorset on the River Yeo at the edge of the Blackmore Vale. It lies 6 miles (9.7 km) east of Yeovil, and the parish includes the hamlets of Nether Coombe and Lower Clatcombe. The 2021 census put the population at 10,361, and the DT9 postcode district covers the town. Much of the old town, including much of the abbey and many medieval and Georgian buildings, is built from honey-brown Sherborne Stone. Yeovil, at 9.3 km, is the closest neighbouring town, with Gillingham at 19.5 km. Service areas are distant. The nearest listed, Warminster Services on the A350, is 37.2 km away in a straight line, so an AdBlue warning on a van or diesel car here needs some planning.
roadsText: The A30 runs through Sherborne, but no listed service area is close by. The nearest listed is Warminster Services on the A350, 37.2 km away in a straight line, with Moto Bridgwater Services on the M5 at 37.5 km and RoadChef Taunton Deane Services, also on the M5, at 44 km. Road distances will be longer, so plan ahead if an AdBlue warning comes on.

name: Shiney Row and Penshaw
intro: Within Houghton-le-Spring in Tyne and Wear, Shiney Row is a village, and the combined Shiney Row and Penshaw area, in the Sunderland district, has a population of 16,900. It falls within the DH4 postcode district. Many trips from here are short, as the surrounding towns are all close: Houghton-le-Spring is 3.1 km away, Washington 4.7 km, Chester-le-Street 6 km and Sunderland 6.4 km, with Birtley at 7 km and Seaham at 9.2 km. The A1(M) is within easy reach too, as Washington services on that road is just 5.3 km away, while Easington services on the A19 is 10.7 km. For a van or diesel car based here, a warning light could appear on a local run between these towns or on a longer trip along the A1(M).
roadsText: Just 5.3 km from Shiney Row and Penshaw, Washington services on the A1(M) is the nearest service area. Easington on the A19 is 10.7 km away and Durham services, back on the A1(M), is 15.5 km. A station with a Durham postcode (DH6 3LJ), 15 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, but the map data is incomplete and closer forecourts may stock it.

name: Shipley
intro: Directly north of Bradford, on the River Aire and the Leeds and Liverpool Canal, Shipley is a historic market town that forms a continuous urban area with the city. It was an urban district in the West Riding of Yorkshire until 1974, and the 2011 Census put the town's population at 15,483. With no break between Shipley and Bradford, it can be hard to say where one ends and the other begins, and the postcode districts listed for the area run from BD1 and BD2 through BD8, BD9 and BD10 to BD17 and BD18. Baildon is just 1.9 km away as the crow flies, Bradford 4.3 km and Bingley 4.8 km. With an AdBlue light on, the roads to know are the A650, A6177, A658, A647, A6120, A657, A6037 and A6038, all of them A roads, and the nearest motorway service area is 13.2 km away.
roadsText: Shipley's main roads are the A650, A6177, A658, A647, A6120, A657, A6037 and A6038, with no motorway among them. The nearest service area is Hartshead Moor on the M62, 13.2 km away as the crow flies. Skelton Lake Service Station on the M1 is 20.4 km away and Woolley Edge on the M1 is 27.4 km. The route by road will be longer in each case.

name: Shirebrook
intro: Shirebrook is a town in Derbyshire's Bolsover district, on the B6407 and close to the A632, the road that runs between Mansfield, Worksop and Bolsover. It had 13,300 residents at the 2021 census, sits near Nottinghamshire's Bassetlaw and Mansfield districts, and is covered by the NG20 postcode district. Mansfield Woodhouse is 4.2 km away, Bolsover 6.2 km, Forest Town 6.7 km and Mansfield 6.9 km, with Sutton in Ashfield 8.6 km off. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the M1 is a little over 10 km away at Tibshelf Services, and a station listed as selling AdBlue at the pump is 8.7 km from the town. Kirkby-in-Ashfield, a little further out, is 11.6 km away.
roadsText: Shirebrook is on the B6407, close to the A632 between Mansfield, Worksop and Bolsover. Tibshelf Services on the M1 is 10.4 km away, Welcome Break Woodall Services, also on the M1, is 13.4 km away and Markham Moor Services on the A1 is 20.4 km away. A station 8.7 km from Shirebrook is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. Its coverage is incomplete, so it may not be the only one.

name: Shoreham-by-Sea
intro: Shoreham, as it is often called, is a coastal town and port in the Adur district of West Sussex, in the middle of the ribbon of urban development along the English south coast. The South Downs border it to the north, the Adur Valley to the west, and the River Adur and Shoreham Beach on the English Channel to the south. Brighton and Hove lies to the east and Worthing to the west, at roughly equal distances. The town had 20,547 residents in 2011 and covers the BN43 and BN42 postcode districts. Southwick is just 2.4 km away and Lancing and Sompting 4 km. The main roads listed around the town include the A27, A259 and A283 among eight A roads, and the nearest listed service area is Pyecombe Services on the A23, 9.8 km away in a straight line.
roadsText: Main roads listed around Shoreham-by-Sea are the A283, A27, A293, A259, A270, A2025, A2038 and A2037. The nearest listed service areas are Pyecombe Services on the A23 at 9.8 km, Ricebridge Services (Hickstead), also on the A23, at 15.6 km, and Buck Barn on the A24 at 18.1 km. A station 10.2 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though OpenStreetMap's records are incomplete.

name: Shrewsbury
intro: The county town of Shropshire, Shrewsbury sits on the River Severn about 15 miles (24km) west of Telford and 33 miles north-west of Wolverhampton. Its parish had 76,782 residents at the 2021 census. The centre keeps a largely undisturbed medieval street plan and has over 660 listed buildings. Postcodes are SY1, SY2 and SY3. The listed roads are all A-roads: the A458, A5, A49, A53, A528, A5191, A5112 and A488. The nearest towns are well spread out, with Telford about 18.9km away, Oswestry 25.6km and Market Drayton 28.2km. For a diesel driver, that can mean plenty of longer A-road runs between towns. With the closest service area 13.3km out and no motorway on the list, an AdBlue warning here is worth planning around.
roadsText: No motorway is among the roads listed for Shrewsbury: the A458, A5, A49, A53, A528, A5191, A5112 and A488. Nesscliffe services on the A5 is the nearest service area, about 13.3km away, and the next two are both about 24km out: Mile End services on the A483 and Telford services on the M54. A driver in SY1, SY2 or SY3 with an AdBlue warning has at least 13.3km to cover to reach a service area.

name: Sidmouth
intro: With a large part of the town designated a conservation area, Sidmouth is a tourist resort on the English Channel in Devon, 14 miles (23 km) south-east of Exeter, and a gateway to the Jurassic Coast World Heritage Site. It had 13,258 residents in 2021, and its postcode district is EX10. For anyone driving a van or diesel car here, motorway services are some way off: the nearest listed service area is Moto Exeter Services on the M5, 16 km away in a straight line, and the other two listed, also on the M5, are 21.5 km and 26.2 km away. Honiton is the closest neighbouring town at 11.8 km, with Exmouth at 13.1 km and Exeter at 19.4 km. Anyone whose dashboard shows an AdBlue warning in Sidmouth should allow for that distance before setting out.
roadsText: No listed service area is close to Sidmouth. Moto Exeter Services on the M5 is the nearest, 16 km from the town in a straight line, followed by ExtraMSA Cullompton Services at 21.5 km and Moto Tiverton Services at 26.2 km, both also on the M5. Distances by road will be longer, which matters if an AdBlue warning comes on with little range left.

name: Sittingbourne
intro: Beside the Roman Watling Street, and next to the Swale that separates mainland Kent from the Isle of Sheppey, Sittingbourne is an industrial town in the Swale district. It lies 17 miles (27 km) from Canterbury and 45 miles (72 km) from London, and had a population of 54,392 in 2021. The town grew in prominence as a convenient resting point on the road from London to Canterbury and Dover. Postcode districts are ME9 and ME10. The M2, A249 and A2 make up its road list. Minster is 9.5 km away, Sheerness 10 km and Faversham 10.9 km, with Gillingham at 11 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service area is 9.2 km away on the M2, and a second is 12.4 km away on the M20.
roadsText: Only three main roads are listed for Sittingbourne: the M2, A249 and A2. Medway Services on the M2 is the nearest listed service area, 9.2 km away, followed by Maidstone Services on the M20 at 12.4 km. Ashford International Truckstop on the A2070 is further out at 27.3 km. A station in Strood (ME2 2NY), 18.4 km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; that data is incomplete.

name: Skegness
intro: Winthorpe and Seacroft are both part of Skegness, a seaside town on the Lincolnshire coast of the North Sea and the largest settlement in East Lindsey, with 21,128 residents in 2021. It lies 47 miles (76 km) east of Lincoln and 25 miles (40 km) north-east of Boston, and is on the A52 and A158, which connect it with Boston and the East Midlands, and with Lincoln. The town also forms a larger built-up area with the resorts of Ingoldmells and Chapel St Leonards to the north. Its postcode district is PE25. Distances here are long. The nearest neighbouring town, Boston, is about 29.6 km away, and the closest service areas are all close to 40 km out, so an AdBlue warning here is worth acting on early rather than leaving it until the next service area.
roadsText: Skegness is on the A52 and A158, which link it with Boston and the East Midlands, and with Lincoln. The nearest service areas are a long way off: Sutterton Services on the A16 at about 38.9 km, Sutterton Truck Stop on the A17 at 39.2 km and Bicker Bar Services on the A52 at 39.6 km.

name: Skelmersdale
intro: Known locally as Skem, Skelmersdale is a West Lancashire town on the River Tawd, 6 miles west of Wigan, 13 miles north-east of Liverpool and 15 miles south-west of Preston. It appears in the Domesday Book and grew as a coal town on the Lancashire Coalfield, but much of the present town, including the town centre, was built as a second wave new town in the 1960s. Its population was 38,813 in 2006, and its postcode district is WN8. The M58 and M6 are both listed among the roads around the town for longer journeys, and Orrell is 4.9 km away, with Ormskirk at 6.7 km. If an AdBlue warning comes on, the fuel station at Old Meadow Services on the M58, 9.4 km away, is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Skelmersdale's listed roads are the M58 and M6, with the A577, A570, A5209, A5068 and A506. Old Meadow Services on the M58 is the nearest service area at 9.4 km, then Charnock Richard Services on the M6 at 10.7 km and Earlsfield Services on the M57 at 14 km. OpenStreetMap lists the station at Old Meadow as selling AdBlue at the pump, along with a site in Warrington (WA5 3TP) at 17.7 km and an HGV-only site in Liverpool. Treat that as a starting point, not a full list.

name: Skipton
intro: Skipton-in-Craven, as the town is also known, is a market town in North Yorkshire lying generally south of the Yorkshire Dales, on both the River Aire and the Leeds and Liverpool Canal. It was historically in the West Riding, and the 2021 census recorded 15,042 residents. Leeds is 27 miles (43 km) to the south-east and York 38 miles (61 km) to the east. Postcodes here use BD23. Barnoldswick is about 11.8 km away, Keighley 12.3 km and Ilkley 12.6 km, with Colne at 15 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, services are some way off: the nearest listed is Hollin Bank Service Station on the M65, around 19.8 km in a straight line, and Hartshead Moor Services on the M62 is about 32.6 km away.
roadsText: Skipton's nearest listed service area is Hollin Bank Service Station on the M65, about 19.8 km in a straight line. Hartshead Moor Services on the M62 is about 32.6 km away and Blackburn with Darwen Services on the M65 about 40.7 km. With the nearest option close to 20 km off, it is worth working out your route before a warning becomes urgent.

name: Sleaford
intro: At the edge of the Fenlands, Sleaford is a market town and the largest settlement in Lincolnshire's North Kesteven district, with 19,807 residents in 2021. It lies 11 miles (18 km) north-east of Grantham, 16 miles (26 km) west of Boston and 17 miles (27 km) south of Lincoln. The urban area includes Quarrington to the south-west, Holdingham to the north-west and Old Sleaford to the east, and the town is bypassed by the A17 and the A15. The postcode district is NG34. Grantham is about 18.1 km away and North Hykeham 24.3 km, with Lincoln, Bourne and Boston all around 26 km. With the nearest service areas also more than 18 km away, a driver with an AdBlue warning around Sleaford should plan a stop rather than rely on finding one close by.
roadsText: Sleaford is bypassed by the A17 and the A15. The nearest service areas are Bicker Bar Services on the A52, about 18.6 km away, and Moto Grantham North Services on the A1 at 18.8 km, with Thorpe on the Hill Services on the A46 further out at around 24.4 km.

name: Slough
intro: Sitting at the intersection of the M4, M40 and M25 motorways, Slough is a Thames Valley town in Berkshire, 20 miles (32 km) west of central London and 19 miles (31 km) north-east of Reading. The town had a population of 143,184 in 2021, with 158,500 in the wider borough. It is a major trading centre, and Slough Trading Estate, with over 17,000 jobs in 400 businesses, is the largest industrial estate in single private ownership in Europe. Postcode districts include SL0 to SL4. Windsor is 5.8 km away, Maidenhead 9.4 km, and Hillingdon and Egham are both 10.3 km. Despite all that motorway access, none of the listed service areas is in the town itself, so a driver with an AdBlue warning will find the nearest ones out on the M40 and M4.
roadsText: Three motorways, the M4, M40 and M25, are listed around Slough, together with the A4, A332, A412, A355 and A308. The nearest listed service area is Beaconsfield Services on the M40, 8.3 km away, followed by Heston Services on the M4 at 14.2 km. Bourne End Services on the A41 is further out at 25.2 km. Depending on which motorway you join, either of the first two is a sensible stop to check.

name: Smethwick
intro: Historically in Staffordshire and then Worcestershire, Smethwick is now an industrial town in the Sandwell district of the West Midlands county, just 4 miles (6km) west of Birmingham city centre. The wider built-up area subdivision has a population of 53,653. Postcode districts listed for the town are B66, B67, B68, B16, B17, B18, B21 and B70. Roads around it include the M5, A38(M), A4031, A41, A456, A4123, A4540 and A458. Oldbury is about 3km away, West Bromwich 4.4km and Rowley Regis 5km. Driving here is close-quarters urban work between the town and Birmingham, with the M5 nearby for longer runs. Frankley services is about 7.6km out.
roadsText: A forecourt in Warley, about 4.5km from Smethwick, is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, along with an HGV-only site in Birmingham (B25 8DW) about 9.6km away. Those records are incomplete. The nearest service areas are Frankley services on the M5 at about 7.6km, Hopwood Park services on the M42 at 14.3km and Hilton Park services on the M6 at 17.8km. Listed roads include the M5, A38(M), A4031, A41, A456, A4123, A4540 and A458.

name: Snodland
intro: Lying on the River Medway between Rochester and Maidstone, Snodland is a town in the borough of Tonbridge and Malling in Kent, 34 miles (55 km) from central London. The 2011 census counted 10,211 residents, and the postcode district is ME6. Larkfield is the nearest neighbour at 3.4 km, with Chatham at 7.3 km, Rochester at 7.8 km and Maidstone at 8.6 km, so several towns are within a short drive. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, three service areas are listed between 11.3 km and 13.9 km away in a straight line: Tollgate Services on the A2, Medway Services on the M2 and Maidstone Services on the M20. Closer still, a station at Temple Farm in Strood, 6.8 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though that data is not complete.
roadsText: Three service areas sit at similar distances from Snodland in a straight line: Tollgate Services on the A2 at 11.3 km, Medway Services on the M2 at 11.5 km and Maidstone Services on the M20 at 13.9 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station at Temple Farm, Strood (ME2 2NY), 6.8 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. The listing is incomplete, so other stations may sell it.

name: Soham
intro: Just off the A142 between Ely and Newmarket, Soham is a town and civil parish in the East Cambridgeshire district of Cambridgeshire. Its population was 12,336 at the 2021 census, and the town falls within the CB7 postcode district. Ely, 9.1 km away, and Newmarket, 10.6 km away, are its closest neighbours. Beyond those two, the larger places are further out: Cambridge is 19.9 km away, Chatteris 23.9 km, Bury St Edmunds 27.1 km and St Ives 28.2 km. Service areas are also some distance off, with the nearest, Four Went Ways on the A11, 24.4 km from the town. For a van or diesel car based here, that adds up to a lot of driving between towns, and a fair way to go before reaching a service area if an AdBlue warning appears mid-journey.
roadsText: Soham sits just off the A142. The nearest service areas are all more than 24 km away: Four Went Ways on the A11 at 24.4 km, Cambridge services on the A14 at 24.7 km, and Caxton Gibbet on the A428 at 32.2 km. With stops that far out, a dashboard warning is better dealt with before setting off on a longer run than left until the next services.

name: Solihull
intro: On the River Blythe in the Forest of Arden area, Solihull is a market town about 8 miles (13km) south-east of Birmingham and 14 miles west of Coventry. The town had 126,577 residents at the 2021 census. It is mostly urban, but the wider borough is rural in character, with many outlying villages and three quarters of its land designated as green belt. Historically in Warwickshire, it joined the West Midlands metropolitan county in 1974. Postcode districts include B90, B91, B92 and B93, along with B27, B28, B47 and B14. Listed roads are the M42, A34, A41, A45, A435, A4545, A4040 and A3400. Driving here can swing between town streets, the rural parts of the borough and the M42. Knowle and Dorridge is about 5.4km away and Birmingham 8.8km, so many trips are short.
roadsText: Solihull's nearest service areas are Hopwood Park services on the M42 at about 10.7km, Frankley services on the M5 at 14.4km and Corley services on the M6 at 19.1km. Listed roads are the M42, A34, A41, A45, A435, A4545, A4040 and A3400. OpenStreetMap lists an HGV-only refuelling site in Birmingham (B25 8DW), about 6.2km away, and a forecourt in Warley, about 18.7km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. Its coverage is incomplete.

name: Somercotes and Swanwick
intro: Somercotes, which this page covers together with Swanwick, is a former mining village in Derbyshire's Amber Valley district, close to the Nottinghamshire border. It was once surrounded by more than five pits and is increasingly urbanised, although there is still some farmland in the northern and western parts of the parish. Industrial areas at Cotes Park and Birchwood sit within it. The combined area has a population of 15,105 and falls in the DE55 postcode district. South Normanton and Pinxton is 3.9 km away and Ripley 4.1 km, with Heanor 7.2 km and Kirkby-in-Ashfield and Belper both 8.7 km off. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the M1 is within reach, with Tibshelf Services 7.4 km away.
roadsText: Tibshelf Services on the M1 is the nearest service area, 7.4 km from Somercotes and Swanwick. Trowell Services, also on the M1, is 14.6 km away and Trent Bridge Services on the A6011 is 21.9 km away. A station 16.1 km away is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That record is not a complete list, and nearer forecourts may well stock AdBlue.

name: South Elmsall
intro: East of Hemsworth, South Elmsall is a town and civil parish in the City of Wakefield, West Yorkshire. Its population grew from 6,107 in 2001 to 6,519 at the 2011 Census, and it is covered by the WF9 postcode district. Adwick le Street is the nearest neighbouring town at 6.4 km, with Cudworth and Shafton at 8.9 km, Scawthorpe and Cusworth at 9.5 km, Featherstone at 10.5 km, Pontefract at 10.7 km and Bentley at 11 km. For anyone with an AdBlue warning on a van or diesel car, the main point is that Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 is 4.4 km from the centre in a straight line, nearer than any of those neighbouring towns. Two M62 service areas follow at 11.2 km and 15 km, and a station in Pontefract, 6.3 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 is the nearest service area to South Elmsall, 4.4 km away in a straight line. On the M62, Ferrybridge Services is 11.2 km away and the Whitwood service area 15 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Pontefract (WF7 7HX), 6.3 km away, and one in Doncaster (DN4 0TP), 13.1 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. That list is incomplete.

name: South Hayling
intro: About 5 miles from Havant, on Hayling Island, South Hayling is a village and former civil parish in Hampshire's Havant district. Its built-up area is classed as a smaller seaside town, and in 2020 it had an estimated population of 15,948. The parish was abolished on 1 April 1932 and merged with Havant. Its postcode district is PO11. Being on an island shapes how a driver reaches services. The nearest listed service area is Farlington Services on the A27, 6.8 km away in a straight line, while the next two, Fontwell Services on the A27 and Petersfield Services on the A3, are both about 24 km away. Emsworth (7.2 km), Havant (7.6 km) and Portsmouth (7.9 km) are the closest towns, with Waterlooville at 10.6 km and Gosport at 12.4 km. If an AdBlue warning appears, Farlington is the obvious first stop by distance.
roadsText: Farlington Services on the A27 is the closest service area to South Hayling, 6.8 km away in a straight line. Beyond that the choice thins out: Fontwell Services, also on the A27, is 24 km away and Petersfield Services on the A3 is 24.3 km. From an island, the road route will be longer than these straight-line figures, which is worth knowing if an AdBlue warning has come on.

name: South Normanton and Pinxton
intro: Former mining village South Normanton, two miles east of Alfreton, is a civil parish in Derbyshire's Bolsover district, and this page covers it together with Pinxton. Its collieries closed between 1952 and 1969, and it had 9,445 residents at the 2011 census. The area falls within the DE55 postcode district. Somercotes and Swanwick is 3.9 km away, Kirkby-in-Ashfield 5.4 km and Sutton in Ashfield 5.9 km, with Ripley at 7.7 km. For drivers, the M1 is close: Tibshelf Services is only 4.3 km from the area. That puts a motorway stop within easy reach if a van or diesel car shows an AdBlue warning, and a station listed as selling AdBlue at the pump is 12.4 km away.
roadsText: Tibshelf Services on the M1 is 4.3 km from South Normanton and Pinxton, which puts a motorway stop close at hand. Trowell Services, also on the M1, is 15.8 km away and Trent Bridge Services on the A6011 is 21.7 km away. A station 12.4 km away is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though its records are incomplete and other stations may sell it too.

name: South Ockendon
intro: Just outside the M25 and close to the border with Greater London, South Ockendon is a Thurrock town of 22,440 people at the 2021 census, with North Ockendon lying to its north. It was historically a parish, but the parish was abolished for civil purposes in 1936, when the town became part of Thurrock. The town is covered by the RM15 postcode district. With the M25 so near, Thurrock Services on that motorway is only 2.8 km from the centre, a useful marker if an AdBlue warning comes on, and Orsett Cock Services on the A13 is 7.2 km away. Chafford Hundred and West Thurrock is 3.5 km away and Grays 4.2 km, with Chadwell St Mary at 6.3 km. Swanscombe and Tilbury are both 7.3 km off, and Dartford is 8.4 km away.
roadsText: The M25 runs just outside South Ockendon, and Thurrock Services on it is the nearest service area at 2.8 km in a straight line. Orsett Cock Services on the A13 is 7.2 km away and Tollgate Services on the A2 is 11.6 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station 15.3 km away and a forecourt in Strood (ME2 2NY), 19.2 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. Mapping of AdBlue is patchy, so treat those as examples rather than a full list.

name: South Queensferry
intro: Three bridges frame South Queensferry: the town stands on the southern shore of the Firth of Forth between the Forth Rail Bridge, the Forth Road Bridge and the Queensferry Crossing. Also known simply as Queensferry or The Ferry, it is a former royal burgh of West Lothian now administered by the City of Edinburgh Council, north-west of Edinburgh city centre. The ferry that gave the town its name ran from the 11th century until 1964, when the Road Bridge opened. The 2022 census counted 10,216 residents, and the town is in the EH30 postcode district. Rosyth is 5.9 km away in a straight line, Broxburn 8.1 km and Dunfermline 9.5 km, with Edinburgh at 12.6 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed services are Dreghorn Services on the A720, 14.1 km away in a straight line.
roadsText: Dreghorn Services on the A720 is the closest listed service area to South Queensferry, 14.1 km away in a straight line. Musselburgh Services on the A1 is 22 km away and Kinross Services on the M90 is 25 km away. All three are straight-line distances from the town centre; the drive will be longer, so check the AdBlue range before setting out for any of them.

name: South Shields
intro: Known in Roman times as Arbeia, South Shields is a coastal port town in South Tyneside, on the south bank at the mouth of the River Tyne. It is the fourth largest settlement in Tyne and Wear, with 75,337 people in 2021, and was historically part of County Durham before joining the newly formed county of Tyne and Wear in 1974. North Shields and Tynemouth lie across the river to the north, while Newcastle upon Tyne and Jarrow are to the west. Among the main roads listed are the A19, A183, A184, A185, A194, A1018, A1058 and A1300, and the postcode districts include NE33, NE34, NE35 and NE36. Jarrow is 3.6km away, Tynemouth 4.8km and Hebburn 5.8km. The nearest listed service area is 13.1km away, so a diesel van or car with an AdBlue warning is more likely to be on the town's own roads than near a service area.
roadsText: South Shields' main roads include the A1018, A1300, A194, A19, A184, A1058, A183 and A185. The nearest listed service areas are Washington Services on the A1(M) at 13.1km, Seaton Burn Services on the A19 at 16.6km and Easington Services on the A19 at 19.9km. A station in Newcastle upon Tyne, 13km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; that list is not complete.

name: South Woodham Ferrers
intro: East of Fenn Creek and close to where it meets the River Crouch, South Woodham Ferrers is a town of 16,026 people in the City of Chelmsford district. It lies about 8 miles (13 km) south-east of Chelmsford and roughly 35 miles (56 km) east of London, and it is covered by the CM3 postcode district. Several neighbouring towns are close: Hockley and Hawkwell is 5.4 km away, Rayleigh 5.8 km and Wickford 7.5 km, with Rochford and Thundersley and South Benfleet a little over 9 km off. Maldon is 11.6 km away. The nearest listed service area, Boreham Services on the A131, is 13.8 km away in a straight line, which is worth knowing if an AdBlue warning comes on during a local run.
roadsText: Boreham Services on the A131 is the closest service area to South Woodham Ferrers, 13.8 km away in a straight line. Orsett Cock Services on the A13 is 20.8 km off and Thurrock Services on the M25 is 28.8 km. OpenStreetMap lists lorry pumps at a site in Chelmsford (CM2 5PY), 13.7 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump, but these are mapped as HGV-only and may not serve vans or cars. The listing is incomplete, so other forecourts may also sell AdBlue.

name: Southampton
intro: At the northernmost point of Southampton Water, where the rivers Test and Itchen meet, Southampton is a major port city with a population of 248,922 at the 2021 census. It forms part of the South Hampshire conurbation alongside Portsmouth, Havant, Eastleigh, Fareham and Gosport, and lies close to the New Forest. Postcode districts include SO14 through to SO19, plus SO30 and SO50. Motorways listed for the area are the M27, M3 and M271, with A roads including the A33, A35 and A335, so driving here covers both city streets and motorway. Neighbouring places are very close: West End is 4 km away, Hedge End 6.1 km and Eastleigh 6.5 km. Anyone with an AdBlue warning in Southampton has the advantage of a listed service area under 6 km away, with two more within 16.7 km.
roadsText: Motorways around Southampton include the M27, M3 and M271, alongside the A33, A335, A3035, A3024 and A35. The nearest listed service area is Rownhams Services on the M27, 5.8 km away. West Wellow Services on the A36 is 11 km and Rufus Stone on the A31 is 16.7 km. All three are within a short drive, giving drivers on different routes out of the city a listed stop to aim for.

name: Southend-on-Sea
intro: Along the north side of the Thames Estuary in south-eastern Essex, 40 miles (64 km) east of central London, lies the coastal city of Southend-on-Sea, commonly called Southend. A unitary authority, it is bordered by Rochford to the north and Castle Point to the west, and is one of the most densely populated places in the country outside London, with London Southend Airport north of the city centre. Postcode districts include SS0, SS1, SS2, SS3, SS4, SS5 and SS9. The main roads are A roads, including the A13 and A127 alongside the A1015, A1158, A1159 and A1160. Rochford is about 3.5 km away, Hockley and Hawkwell 6.2 km and Rayleigh 8 km. None of the nearest service areas is within 21 km, so a driver who sees an AdBlue warning on a local run has no quick stop of that kind to fall back on.
roadsText: Southend-on-Sea's main roads are the A13, A127, A1015, A1158, A1159 and A1160. The nearest service areas are all some way off: Orsett Cock Services on the A13 at about 21.1 km, Moto Medway Services on the M2 at 24.6 km, and Boreham Services on the A131 at around 25.4 km.

name: Southport
intro: About 17 miles north of Liverpool and 15 miles south-west of Preston, Southport lies on the West Lancashire coastal plain, facing the Irish Sea. It is a seaside town in the Metropolitan Borough of Sefton and had 94,421 residents at the 2021 census, making it the third most populous settlement in the Liverpool City Region. The town was founded in 1792, and Lord Street was developed as a wide, tree-lined shopping street. For drivers, the road list is short and has no motorway: the A570, A565, A5267 and A5147. Postcode districts PR8 and PR9 cover the town. Formby (9.8 km) and Ormskirk (10.9 km) are the nearest towns, with Lytham St Anne's at 12.8 km, Maghull at 14.2 km and Longton and Crosby a little over 16 km away. The closest service area in the data is 14.6 km off on the M58.
roadsText: Southport's main roads are the A570, A565, A5267 and A5147. The nearest service area is Old Meadow Services on the M58, 14.6 km away, followed by Charnock Richard Services on the M6 at 19.8 km and Earlsfield Services on the M57 at 25.5 km. A station at Old Meadow, 14.5 km off, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap, but its data is incomplete and closer sites may exist.

name: Southwark
intro: Bridges across the River Thames connect Southwark to the City of London and to Tower Hamlets. This South London borough forms part of Inner London, was created in 1965 when three smaller council areas were combined, and has all of its districts inside the London postal district. Major districts include Bermondsey, Rotherhithe, Peckham, Camberwell and Dulwich, while the stretch of the South Bank within the borough takes in London Bridge terminus station and Borough Market. The borough has about 307,076 residents. Postcode districts include SE1, SE5, SE11, SE14, SE15, SE16 and SE17, plus E1W. All of the main roads listed are A-roads: the A2, A3, A100, A201, A202, A302, A1203 and A3204. Tower Hamlets is 4.4km away and Lewisham 5.5km, so a short drive can take a van with an AdBlue warning across a borough boundary.
roadsText: The main roads listed for Southwark are the A2, A202, A100, A201, A3, A3204, A302 and A1203. Service areas are well outside the borough: London Gateway Services on the M1 is 21.1km away, Heston Services on the M4 22.1km and Thurrock Services on the M25 23.8km. A station at Catford, 6.3km away, and another 12.3km away are listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap, which does not record every outlet.

name: Southwater
intro: A large village rather than a town, Southwater is a civil parish in the Horsham District of West Sussex with a population of roughly 10,000. Horsham itself is only 4.5 km away, but beyond it the nearest towns are some distance off: Crawley and Cranleigh are both 15.2 km, Hassocks and Hurstpierpoint 17 km, Burgess Hill 17.6 km and Haywards Heath 18.4 km. Southwater falls in the RH13 postcode district, and the parish is administered by Horsham District Council and West Sussex County Council. If an AdBlue warning appears, the nearest listed service area, Buck Barn on the A24, is just 4.7 km away in a straight line, with two more on the A23 and M23 within 12.1 km.
roadsText: Three service areas sit fairly close to Southwater. Buck Barn on the A24 is the nearest at 4.7 km in a straight line, Handcross on the A23 is 10.9 km away, and Pease Pottage Services on the M23 is 12.1 km. Between them they cover the A24, A23 and M23, so a driver in RH13 has a choice depending on direction of travel. Road distances will be longer than these figures.

name: Southwick
intro: Three loosely defined sections make up Southwick, a town in the Adur district of West Sussex five miles (8 km) west of Brighton. South of Brighton Road is the harbour with its industries and businesses. Between Brighton Road and Old Shoreham Road the properties are mainly residential, dating from the mid-19th century to the 1950s, and the area between Old Shoreham Road and the South Downs is the most recent to be developed. The A259 coast road passes through the town, while the A27 bypasses it to the north. Southwick had 13,195 residents in 2001 and is covered by the BN42, BN41 and BN43 postcode districts. Shoreham-by-Sea is 2.4 km away and Lancing and Sompting 6.4 km. For an AdBlue warning, Pyecombe Services on the A23 is the nearest listed service area at 8.3 km in a straight line, and a station 7.7 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: The A259 coast road runs through Southwick, and the A27 bypasses the town to the north. The nearest service area is Pyecombe Services on the A23 at 8.3 km in a straight line, followed by Ricebridge Services (Hickstead), also on the A23, at 15 km and Buck Barn on the A24 at 18.9 km. A station 7.7 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though the map is incomplete.

name: Spalding
intro: Spalding, the administrative centre of South Holland, is a Lincolnshire market town on the River Welland, north-east of the city of Peterborough. It had 30,556 residents at the 2021 census. The town's flower parade celebrates the region's large tulip production and the cultural links between the Fens and South Holland. The postcode district is PE11, and the main roads are the A16, A151 and A1175. Other towns are some distance away: Bourne is about 14.7 km, Boston 23.5 km and Peterborough 24.2 km, with Whittlesey and Wisbech both around 24.9 km. Service areas are much closer than that. Lincs Gateway Services on the A16 is only about 2.2 km away and Springfield Services on the A151 about 3.1 km, so a driver with an AdBlue warning has somewhere close to stop.
roadsText: Spalding's main roads are the A16, A151 and A1175. Lincs Gateway Services on the A16 is about 2.2 km away and Springfield Services on the A151 about 3.1 km, with Sutterton Truck Stop on the A17 around 13.1 km out. A BP station near Bourne (PE10 0EN), about 15.1 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump; the data is incomplete.

name: Spennymoor
intro: South of the River Wear and 11 km south of Durham, Spennymoor is a town and civil parish in County Durham. As well as the town, the parish covers the villages of Kirk Merrington, Middlestone Moor, Byers Green and Tudhoe, so local driving takes in both the town and these surrounding villages. The parish population was 19,816 in 2011, and the area uses the DL16 postcode district. Durham is 8.7 km away, Bishop Auckland 9 km and Newton Aycliffe 9.6 km, while Houghton-le-Spring, Peterlee and Chester-le-Street are all between 16.6 km and 16.7 km. The A1(M) is close by, with Durham services on that road just 5 km from Spennymoor, so a van or diesel car can be on the motorway within a short distance of leaving town, and a warning light could come on during a motorway leg or a village run.
roadsText: Spennymoor is well placed for the A1(M): Durham services is 5 km away and Bradbury services, on the same road, 8.3 km. Sedgefield services on the A689 is 11.7 km out. In OpenStreetMap, a station with a Durham postcode (DH6 3LJ), 11.9 km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete, so it should not be taken as the only option.

name: St Albans
intro: A cathedral city 20 miles (32 km) north-west of London, St Albans sits east of Hemel Hempstead and west of Hatfield, 8 miles (13 km) south-west of Welwyn Garden City and 11 miles (18 km) south-east of Luton. It was the first major town on the old Roman road of Watling Street for travellers heading north, and became the city of Verulamium. Its population is given as 82,146. Three motorways, the M25, M1 and A1(M), are listed among the city's main roads, along with the A414, A405, A1057, A1081 and A4147, so a diesel driver here has several motorway routes within reach.
