A station in Manchester (M25 3AJ), just 1.3 km away, and another 10.1 km away are listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That map data is incomplete.

name: Whitehaven
intro: A port on the north-west coast of Cumbria, Whitehaven lies 6 km outside the Lake District National Park and 56 km south-west of Carlisle. Its growth came from coal: the Lowther family exploited the extensive coal measures and exported coal through the harbour from the 17th century, and the prosperity that followed produced a Georgian planned town, which has left more than 170 listed buildings. The built-up area had 22,945 residents in 2021, and the parish, which also includes Sandwith, had 24,040. Whitehaven is in the CA28 postcode district. Apart from Workington, 11.2 km away, the nearest towns are a long way off: Ulverston is 50 km, Barrow-in-Furness 52.2 km and Penrith 54.7 km. That distance matters for a diesel van or car, because the nearest motorway services are more than 50 km away.
roadsText: Whitehaven is a long way from any motorway service area. The three nearest are all on the M6: Southwaite at 53.7 km, Golden Fleece at 57.2 km and Todhills at 59.7 km. Closer to home, a station in Distington (CA14 4PJ), 7.7 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That map data is incomplete, so other local forecourts may also sell it.

name: Whitley Bay
intro: Formerly governed as part of Northumberland, Whitley Bay is a seaside town in the North Tyneside borough that has been part of Tyne and Wear since 1974. It sits within the wider Tyneside built-up area, around 10 miles (16 km) north-east of Newcastle upon Tyne city centre, and had 38,323 residents at the 2021 census. Two notable landmarks are the Spanish City, a domed building on the seafront, and St Mary's Lighthouse, on a small island near the town. Its listed main roads are the A19, A186, A191, A192, A193, A1058, A1108 and A1148, and the town's postcodes include NE25, NE26, NE27, NE29 and NE30. Tynemouth is 3.6km away, Wallsend 6km and Killingworth 6.9km. Should an AdBlue warning appear, the nearest listed service area is Seaton Burn on the A19, 10.8km away.
roadsText: Whitley Bay has the A1058, A19, A1148, A192, A193, A191, A186 and A1108 among its main roads. Seaton Burn Services on the A19 is 10.8km away, then Washington Services on the A1(M) at 18.4km and Easington Services on the A19 at 27.9km. A station in Newcastle upon Tyne, 8.3km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; that source is incomplete.

name: Whitstable
intro: Whitstable sits on the north coast of Kent, at the convergence of the Swale and the Greater Thames Estuary. It is a town in the Canterbury district five miles north of Canterbury and two miles west of Herne Bay, and the 2021 census recorded 32,196 people. Its postcode district is CT5. Whitstable was long famous for oysters, and its harbour, built in 1832 to handle coal and other bulk cargo, still plays an important role in the town's economy. The road list is short: the A299, A2990 and A290. Herne is 6.6km away, Herne Bay 8km and Canterbury 8.7km, with Faversham at 11km. With no motorway on the road list, most driving here is on A roads, and the nearest service area is 19.8km away.
roadsText: Main roads listed around Whitstable are the A299, A2990 and A290. Service areas are some distance off: Minster Services on the A299 is 19.8km away, Ashford International Truckstop on the A2070 is 26.7km and Folkestone Services on the M20 is 28.5km. With the closest stop that far out, it makes sense to act on an AdBlue warning before a longer run.

name: Whittlesey
intro: Also spelt Whittlesea, Whittlesey is a historic market town in the Fenland district of Cambridgeshire, 6 miles (10 km) east of Peterborough. Its built-up area had 13,823 residents at the 2021 census, while the wider parish had 17,667. The town falls in the PE7 postcode district. Peterborough is 9.5 km from the centre, March is 14 km away and Chatteris 16.1 km. Wisbech, Huntingdon and Spalding are all between 22.7 km and 24.9 km from the town. For an AdBlue warning, the nearest service areas are on the A1 and A1(M): Peterborough Services is 13.9 km away in a straight line and Kate's Cabin is 14.4 km, with the Sawtry service area at 17.6 km.
roadsText: Three service areas lie within 17.6 km of Whittlesey in a straight line, all on the A1 or A1(M): Peterborough Services on the A1(M) at 13.9 km, Kate's Cabin on the A1 at 14.4 km and the Sawtry service area on the A1(M) at 17.6 km. A station 14 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That mapping is incomplete, so it may not be the only place selling AdBlue.

name: Whitwick
intro: In the north-west of Leicestershire, some two miles north of Coalville, Whitwick is a large village and civil parish in the North West Leicestershire district. Its ancient parish once included the villages of Thringstone and Swannington, and as early as 1293 it had a weekly market. Whitwick is 4 miles south-west of Shepshed, 6 miles east of Ashby-de-la-Zouch and 8 miles west-south-west of Loughborough, and had 8,612 residents at the 2011 census. It shares the LE67 postcode district with Coalville, which is just 1.6 km away. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest motorway services are 9.8 km away at Moto Donington Park Services on the M1.
roadsText: Moto Donington Park Services on the M1 is the nearest service area to Whitwick, at 9.8 km. Welcome Break Derby South Services on the A50 is 14.5 km away and ExtraMSA Leicester Services on the A6 is 16.3 km away. A station in Swadlincote (DE12 8AA), 14 km away, is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though its records are incomplete and there may be nearer stations that sell it.

name: Wick
intro: Once a separate village, Wick is now a suburb of Littlehampton and part of the built-up area around the town, in the Arun district of West Sussex. It sits on the A284 road, about 1 mile (1 km) to the north of Littlehampton. The area has a population of 13,231 and uses the BN17 postcode district. Wick still has several flint Victorian buildings, including All Saints Church, and holds an annual summer festival. Rustington is 4.6 km away and Barnham 7.5 km, with Worthing and Bognor Regis both just over 10 km off and Lancing and Sompting at 15.4 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, Fontwell Services on the A27 is the nearest listed service area at 8.2 km in a straight line. The next two, Buck Barn on the A24 and Pyecombe Services on the A23, are much further at 23.6 km and 27.5 km.
roadsText: Wick is on the A284 road, about 1 km north of Littlehampton. The nearest listed service area is Fontwell Services on the A27, 8.2 km away in a straight line. Beyond that the options are a long way off: Buck Barn on the A24 at 23.6 km and Pyecombe Services on the A23 at 27.5 km. Road distances will be longer than these figures.

name: Wickersley and Bramley
intro: Very near the road junctions for the M1 and M18, Wickersley is a village and civil parish in the Metropolitan Borough of Rotherham, 3 miles (5 km) from the centre of Rotherham. Together with Bramley, through which the M18 passes, it makes up the area covered here, with a population of 24,653. The motorway network is the defining fact for drivers: both the M18 and the M1 are listed among the main roads, along with the A631, A630, A6021, A6123, A618 and A6178, and Rotherham Services on the M1 is 5.7 km away measured directly. That puts a service area within easy reach if an AdBlue warning appears. The postcode district is S66. Rotherham itself is 4.8 km from the centre, Maltby 5.9 km, Rawmarsh 6 km and Swinton 6.9 km, so short trips can quickly take you into another town.
roadsText: The M18 and M1 are both among the main roads around Wickersley and Bramley, along with the A631, A630, A6021, A6123, A618 and A6178. Rotherham Services on the M1 is 5.7 km away measured directly, Sheffield Service Area on the A6102 is 10.7 km and Woodall services on the M1 is 12.3 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station with a Doncaster address, 10.9 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump; its data is incomplete.

name: Wickford
intro: About 4 miles (6 km) north-east of Basildon and roughly 30 miles (48 km) east of London, Wickford is a town and civil parish in the Borough of Basildon, Essex. At the 2021 census the parish had 27,601 people and the built-up area 27,535. The town has a main high street with a wide range of shops, and a swimming pool, library, open-air market and community centre near the centre. Eight main roads are listed for the town: the A127, A130, A1245, A13, A129, A132, A1235 and A1321. Rayleigh is 5.8 km away, Thundersley and South Benfleet 6.4 km, Billericay 6.7 km, Basildon 6.9 km and South Woodham Ferrers 7.5 km, with Hockley and Hawkwell at 9.6 km. With every listed neighbour that close, a diesel driver with an AdBlue fault has several towns within a short drive. Postcode districts are SS11, SS12 and SS13.
roadsText: Listed roads are the A127, A130, A1245, A13, A129, A132, A1235 and A1321. Orsett Cock Services on the A13 is 13.7 km away, Boreham Services on the A131 16.2 km and Thurrock Services on the M25 21.4 km. Lorry pumps in Chelmsford (CM2 5PY), 16.1 km away, are listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump but are marked HGV-only. The OpenStreetMap data is incomplete.

name: Widnes
intro: The main roads through Widnes are easy to picture: the A557 runs north to south and the A562 east to west. The town sits on the northern bank of the River Mersey where the estuary narrows to form the Runcorn Gap, with Runcorn directly across the river to the south. Warrington is 8 miles upstream to the east, and Speke, a suburb of Liverpool, is 4 miles downstream to the west. Historically in Lancashire, Widnes is now in the Borough of Halton, Cheshire, and had 62,400 people at the 2021 census. WA8 is the postcode district listed. Two motorways, the M62 and M57, are also on the road list. Prescot is 6.3 km away and St Helens 8.5 km, with Huyton with Roby at 9.4 km, Warrington at 10.1 km and Newton-le-Willows at 11.4 km.
roadsText: Beyond the A557 and A562, the main roads around Widnes include the M62 and M57, plus the A533, A57, A570 and A5300. Burtonwood Services on the M62 is 8.1 km away and Earlsfield Services on the M57 8.8 km, with Chester Services on the M56 at 12.3 km. Stations in Warrington's WA5 (6.5 km) and WA3 (14.7 km) are listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; its records are incomplete.

name: Wigan
intro: Midway between Manchester and Liverpool, Wigan lies 16 miles from the first and 17 miles from the second. It is the largest settlement in the Metropolitan Borough of Wigan and its administrative centre, with a town population of 107,732 and 330,714 across the borough. Historically in Lancashire, it grew into a major mill town within a large coal mining district during the Industrial Revolution, though coal mining ceased in the later 20th century. The M6 and M58 are both on the road list, along with the A577, A49, A5209, A58, A571 and A573. Postcode districts WN1, WN3, WN5 and WN6 are listed. Neighbouring places are close: Ince-in-Makerfield is 2.9 km away, Orrell and Standish 4.4 km, Platt Bridge and Abram 4.7 km, Hindley 5.3 km and Ashton-in-Makerfield 6 km. Two service areas are within 10 km of town.
roadsText: Wigan's main roads include the M6 and M58, plus the A577, A49, A5209, A58, A571 and A573. Rivington Services on the M61 is 7.8 km away and Charnock Richard Services on the M6 9.8 km, with Burtonwood Services on the M62 at 14.4 km. Stations in Warrington's WA5 (15.1 km) and WA3 (16.4 km) districts and at Old Meadow (17.5 km) are listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; it may well have missed nearer ones.

name: Wigston
intro: Also known as Wigston Magna, this Leicestershire town lies just south of Leicester on the A5199, in the Oadby and Wigston district. It had 37,261 residents in 2024, and the postcode districts covering it are LE2, LE8 and LE18. Neighbouring places are close: Oadby is about 3.1 km away, Blaby and Whetstone 4.2 km and Leicester itself 5.5 km, with Enderby and Narborough at 6.2 km and Leicester Forest East and Kirby Muxloe at 8.4 km. The M1 and M69 are both among the main roads, along with the A6, A426, A563 and A5199, plus the A5460 and A6030. Leicester Forest East Services on the M1 is the nearest service area at about 7.2 km, which makes it the obvious stop if an AdBlue warning appears on a motorway run.
roadsText: The main roads listed for Wigston are the M1, M69, A6, A426, A563, A5199, A5460 and A6030. Leicester Forest East Services on the M1 is the nearest service area, about 7.2 km away. ExtraMSA Leicester Services on the A6 is around 11.7 km away, and Six Hills Services Northbound on the A46 about 19.1 km.

name: Willenhall
intro: The M6 at Junction 10 separates Willenhall from Walsall, and the town lies between Walsall and Wolverhampton on the River Tame. The market town, part of the Metropolitan Borough of Walsall, is contiguous with both Wolverhampton and South Staffordshire. It was historically famous for making locks and keys, and had 49,587 residents at the 2021 census. Postcodes include WV11, WV12 and WV13, along with WS2 and WS10. Besides the M6, the listed roads are the M54, M5, A454, A463, A4444, A34 and A4148. Darlaston is about 2.5km away, Bloxwich 3.7km and Bilston 3.8km. That makes for a lot of short trips through joined-up urban areas, with the M6 right on the doorstep for longer journeys. The closest service area is about 5.9km away on the M6.
roadsText: Hilton Park services on the M6, about 5.9km from Willenhall, is the nearest service area. Norton Canes services on the M6 Toll is 9.6km away and a truck stop on the A5 10.1km. Listed roads are the M6, M54, M5, A454, A463, A4444, A34 and A4148. OpenStreetMap lists forecourts in Warley (about 9.7km) and Burntwood (about 12.1km), plus an HGV-only site in Birmingham (20km), as selling AdBlue at the pump, though that list is not complete.

name: Willerby and Anlaby
intro: On the western outskirts of Kingston upon Hull, Willerby grew during the 20th century from a minor settlement into a suburb, with development spreading south-east towards the city. Its village centre is about five miles (8 km) west of Hull city centre and lies outside the city boundary, in the East Riding of Yorkshire. Willerby and Anlaby together have a population of 19,269, and the area falls in the HU10 postcode district. Surrounding places are close: Hessle is about 3 km away and Cottingham 4.1 km, with Kingston upon Hull, Barton-upon-Humber and Brough all between 7.5 km and 7.7 km. Motorway services are a different matter. The nearest listed service area is Ulceby Truckstop on the A160, about 17.9 km in a straight line, and the closest motorway services, Doncaster (North) Services on the M180, is about 40.2 km away, which is worth knowing if an AdBlue warning appears.
roadsText: The closest service area to Willerby and Anlaby is Ulceby Truckstop on the A160, around 17.9 km away in a straight line. After that the distances jump: Doncaster (North) Services on the M180 is about 40.2 km away and Bilbrough Top Service Area on the A64 about 51.5 km. For a van or car with a warning showing, the A160 site is the only one of the three within 20 km.

name: Wilmslow
intro: At the 2021 census the parish of Wilmslow had 26,213 residents and its built-up area 25,725. This Cheshire East market town and civil parish lies 11 miles south of Manchester and 7 miles north-west of Macclesfield. The town falls in the SK9 postcode district. Neighbouring places are spaced a few kilometres apart: Cheadle Hulme is 5.5 km away, Bramhall 6.2 km, Hale 6.3 km, Cheadle 7.1 km and Poynton 7.7 km, with Wythenshawe at 8.2 km. The M56 is the motorway listed for the area, alongside A roads including the A34, A538, A555 and A523. For a driver dealing with an AdBlue warning, the nearest service areas are on the M6 rather than the M56, starting 11.8 km away, so a longer journey may need a planned stop.
roadsText: The M56 is listed around Wilmslow, along with the A538, A34, A555, A523, A5102 and A5149. The closest service areas are Knutsford Services (11.8 km) and Tabley Hill Service Station (12.7 km), both on the M6, followed by Lymm Services, also on the M6, at 18.6 km. Macclesfield is 7 miles away.

name: Wimborne Minster
intro: Where the River Stour meets the River Allen, Wimborne Minster, often just called Wimborne, is a Dorset market town on the Dorset Heaths, 5 miles (8 km) north of Poole. It forms part of the South East Dorset conurbation, and its built-up area had 16,630 people at the 2021 census. The name comes from the Old English winnburna, meaning 'stream by a pasture'. Wimborne is covered by the BH21 postcode district, and the towns around it are close: Ferndown is 4.6 km away, Corfe Mullen 6 km, West Moors 6.3 km and Bournemouth 9.5 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service area is Picket Post Services on the A31, 17.4 km away in a straight line, with Rufus Stone, also on the A31, at 26.4 km.
roadsText: The two nearest listed service areas to Wimborne Minster are both on the A31: Picket Post Services, 17.4 km away in a straight line, and Rufus Stone at 26.4 km. West Wellow Services on the A36 is 34.5 km off. A station at Creekmoor in Poole (BH17 7FR), 7.9 km away, is listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete, so other sites may sell it too.

name: Winchester
intro: Hampshire's county town is a cathedral city on the River Itchen, at the western end of the South Downs National Park. Winchester lies 60 miles south-west of London and 14 miles from Southampton, and the 2021 census counted 48,478 people in its built-up area. Its postcode districts are SO23, SO22 and SO21. It is also home to the head offices of Hampshire County Council. The M3 is the motorway on the road list, with the A34, A33, A31, A272 and A3090 among the other main roads. Chandler's Ford is 9.4km away and Eastleigh 10.2km, with Romsey at 13.4km and Southampton at 16.4km. For anyone driving a diesel van or car here, that puts the city within easy reach of the M3 and of the towns towards Southampton.
roadsText: Main roads listed around Winchester are the M3, A272, A31, A34, A3090 and A33. Winchester Services on the M3 is the closest service area at 7.6km, followed by Sutton Scotney Services on the A34 (10.5km) and Barton Stacey Services on the A303 (13.7km). All three are within 13.7km of the city, on the M3, A34 and A303, which gives a driver with an AdBlue warning on those roads a stop not far out of town.

name: Windsor
intro: Immediately south of the River Thames, which forms its boundary with Eton, Windsor is a historic town in the Royal Borough of Windsor and Maidenhead, Berkshire. It is home to Windsor Castle and lies 21.8 miles west of central London, 5.8 miles south-east of Maidenhead and 15.8 miles east of Reading. Old Windsor is just over 2 miles to the south. Its postcode district is SL4. Drivers have the M4 and A308(M) on the road list, alongside the A308, A332, A355, A4, A412 and A330. Slough is 5.8km away, with Egham and Maidenhead both at 7.6km and Ascot at 8.3km. Expect a mix of town driving and short hops to neighbouring towns, with the M4 for longer trips.
roadsText: The M4, A308(M), A308, A332, A355, A4, A412 and A330 are the main roads listed around Windsor. The nearest service areas are Beaconsfield Services on the M40 (12.7km), Heston Services on the M4 (17.3km) and Wisley Services on the A3 (22.8km). Even with the M4 on the road list, the closest service area is 12.7km from town, so it is worth acting on an AdBlue warning early.

name: Winsford
intro: The River Weaver divides Winsford: Over lies on the western side, Wharton on the eastern side, and Swanlow and Dene make up the third area. The town, in Cheshire West and Chester, sits south of Northwich and west of Middlewich. It grew around salt mining once the river was canalised in the 18th century, which allowed freight to travel north to the Port of Runcorn. Its built-up area had 32,530 people at the 2021 census, and its postcode district is CW7. The roads listed for Winsford are all A roads: the A54, A533, A530, A556 and A5018. Davenham is 5.3 km away, Middlewich 5.6 km and Northwich 7.9 km. If an AdBlue warning comes on, the three nearest service areas are between 12.3 km and 14.9 km out, one on the A49 and two on the M6.
roadsText: The roads listed for Winsford are the A54, A533, A530, A556 and A5018. Whitley Services on the A49 is the closest service area at 12.3 km, followed by Sandbach Services on the M6 at 13.7 km and Knutsford Services, also on the M6, at 14.9 km. Crewe is 11.7 km away and Nantwich 13.7 km.

name: Wisbech
intro: Described as the Capital of The Fens, Wisbech is a market town, inland port and civil parish in the Fenland district, in the far north-east of Cambridgeshire. It borders Norfolk and is only 5 miles (8 km) south of Lincolnshire, so a short drive can take a van or car into another county. The tidal River Nene runs through the town and is spanned by two road bridges, worth knowing when planning a route across town. Wisbech is in the Isle of Ely, a former administrative county, and is noted for its Georgian architecture, particularly along the North Brink. Its population was 31,573 in 2011. Main roads listed are the A47 and A1101. March is 13.5 km away, Downham Market 16.2 km and King's Lynn 20.1 km, with Whittlesey, Chatteris and Spalding all between 22.7 and 24.9 km. The postcode district is PE13.
roadsText: The A47 and A1101 are the roads listed for Wisbech. The nearest service area is Freebridge Park on the A47, 17.1 km away, with Lincs Gateway Services on the A16 at 24 km and Springfield Services on the A151 at 24.2 km. Any of the three means a drive of at least 17.1 km from the town.

name: Wishaw
intro: On the edge of the Clyde Valley, 24 km southeast of Glasgow city centre, Wishaw is a North Lanarkshire town that shares the Motherwell and Wishaw parliamentary constituency with neighbouring Motherwell, only 4.5 km away. The two formed a joint burgh from 1920 until Scottish local authorities were restructured in 1975. Wishaw developed extensively in the Victorian era with steel, iron, manufacturing, textiles and coal processing, and today has a mixed economy with service industries and is a residential area within North Lanarkshire. ML2 is the postcode district and the population is listed at 30,050. The M74 is on the road list with the A71, A72, A73, A721, A722, A723 and A775. Larkhall is 5.4 km away and Carluke 7.5 km, with Bellshill at 7.6 km and Hamilton at 8.6 km. The nearest motorway services are 7.1 km away.
roadsText: Main roads recorded around Wishaw are the M74, A721, A722, A71, A73, A72, A723 and A775. Hamilton Services on the M74 is the nearest service area at 7.1 km, with Bothwell Services, also on the M74, at 9.6 km and Heart of Scotland Services on the M8 at 14.1 km. That gives drivers in Wishaw three service areas within 14.1 km.

name: Witham
intro: Standing on the Roman road between two cities, Witham has Chelmsford 8 miles (13 km) to the south-west and Colchester 13 miles (21 km) to the north-east. It is a town and civil parish in the Braintree district of Essex. The River Brain runs through the town and joins the River Blackwater on the outskirts. At the 2021 census the parish had 27,797 people and the built-up area 27,395. The main road listed for Witham is the A12. Maldon is 8.7 km away, Braintree 10.3 km and Chelmsford 12.8 km, with Halstead at 15.6 km, South Woodham Ferrers 17.9 km and Great Dunmow 20.8 km. The postcode district is CM8. If an AdBlue warning comes on here, the nearest listed service area and a set of HGV-only lorry pumps listed as selling AdBlue are both 9.7 km away, as set out below.
roadsText: The A12 is the main road listed for Witham. Boreham Services on the A131 is 9.7 km away, Ardleigh South Services on the A120 25.8 km and Birchanger Green Services on the M11 31.1 km. Lorry pumps in Chelmsford (CM2 5PY), also 9.7 km away, are listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump, though they are marked HGV-only and that data is incomplete.

name: Witney
intro: On the River Windrush, 12 miles west of Oxford, Witney is a West Oxfordshire market town with a population of 30,167. Its postcode districts are OX28 and OX29. The roads listed for the town are the A40, A4095 and A415, and no motorway appears on that list. Carterton is the nearest neighbouring town at 7.7km, followed by Kidlington at 14km and Oxford at 15.9km, with Abingdon-on-Thames 18.8km away. For a van or diesel car, that points to most driving being on A roads. Service areas are thin on the ground: the closest is 13.9km away and the next two, both on the M40, are 26.7km and 27.2km out. That makes it worth acting on an AdBlue warning early rather than hoping to reach a motorway stop.
roadsText: Witney's road list is short: the A40, A4095 and A415. The nearest service area is Peartree Services on the A44, about 13.9km away. The other two are both on the M40 and much further: Cherwell Valley Services at 26.7km and Oxford Services at 27.2km. A driver who sees an AdBlue warning here has a fair way to go to reach a motorway service area.

name: Woking
intro: When surplus land around the railway station on the London to Southampton line began to be sold for development in the mid-1860s, the modern town of Woking was established. It is now a town and borough in north-west Surrey, around 23 miles (36 km) from central London, and its urban district took in Horsell in 1907 and Byfleet and Pyrford in 1933. Postcode districts are GU21, GU22 and GU24, and the town has a population of around 75,655. The listed roads are all A roads, including the A3, A320, A322 and A245. Guildford is 7.3 km away, Addlestone 9.7 km and Chertsey 9.8 km. Should an AdBlue warning appear on a van or diesel car in Woking, the nearest listed service area is 7.1 km away on the A3.
roadsText: Eight A roads are listed around Woking: the A3, A324, A320, A247, A3046, A322, A245 and A319. Wisley Services on the A3 is the closest listed service area, 7.1 km away. Cobham Services on the M25 is 12.5 km and Fleet Services on the M3 is 18.9 km. Between them, the three cover the A3, M25 and M3, giving drivers in Woking a listed stop on each of those routes.

name: Wokingham
intro: A market town and civil parish in Berkshire, Wokingham is the main administrative centre of the wider Borough of Wokingham. The 2021 census counted 38,284 people in the parish and 50,325 in the wider built-up area, and the town's postcode districts are RG40 and RG41. Its road list gives a real mix of driving: the M4 and A329(M) both appear, alongside the A329, A321, A327, A3095 and A3290. Neighbouring places sit close together here. Crowthorne is 4.5km away, Bracknell 6.4km, Yateley 6.5km and Sandhurst 6.9km, with Woodley at 7.4km and Reading at 9.6km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, that means plenty of short runs between towns, plus motorway routes within reach when a longer trip is needed.
roadsText: Around Wokingham, the main roads listed are the M4, A329(M), A329, A321, A327, A3095 and A3290. The nearest service areas are Fleet Services on the M3 (11.1km), Reading Services on the M4 (13.4km) and Beaconsfield Services on the M40 (26.4km). A station on the Swallowfield By-pass near Reading (RG7 1LZ), about 9.6km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump. OpenStreetMap data is incomplete, so this is not a full list.

name: Wolverhampton
intro: Wolverhampton forms the north-western part of the West Midlands conurbation, about 12 miles (19km) north-west of Birmingham. Willenhall and Walsall lie to the east and Sedgley and Dudley to the south, and the 2021 population was 263,700. The M6 runs just outside the city's east and north-east borders, while the M54 starts to the north and links Wolverhampton with Telford. Other listed roads include the A4150, A449, A41, A460, A454, A4123 and A463. Postcode districts covered include WV1 to WV4, WV6, WV10, WV11 and WV14. Bilston is about 4.7km away, with Willenhall and Codsall at 6km and Coseley, Darlaston and Sedgley between 6.3km and 6.8km. For a diesel van or car, that is a mix of urban driving through closely spaced towns and quick access to two motorways. The closest services are about 8km out on the M6.
roadsText: Around Wolverhampton the listed roads are the M54, A4150, A449, A41, A460, A454, A4123 and A463, and the M6 runs just outside the city. The nearest service areas are Hilton Park services on the M6 at about 8km, a truck stop on the A5 at 11.3km and Norton Canes services on the M6 Toll at 13.9km. OpenStreetMap lists forecourts in Warley (about 11.3km) and Burntwood (WS7 3XA, about 16.6km) as selling AdBlue at the pump, though that list is incomplete.

name: Wombourne
intro: Just 4 miles (6 km) south-west of Wolverhampton, on the border with the West Midlands county, Wombourne is a major village and civil parish in the South Staffordshire district, with its own parish council. Its population rose from 13,691 at the 2001 census to 14,157 in 2011. The postcode district is WV5. Sedgley is 4.8 km away, Kingswinford 5.2 km, Coseley 7 km, Dudley 7.9 km and Brierley Hill 8.4 km. For an AdBlue warning, it helps to know that motorway services are not close: the nearest listed, on the M6, is 15.5 km away in a straight line, with one on the M5 at 16.9 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Warley, 11.5 km off, as selling AdBlue at the pump, though that data is incomplete and nearer stations may sell it too.
roadsText: The nearest service areas to Wombourne are Hilton Park Services on the M6, 15.5 km away in a straight line, Frankley Services on the M5 at 16.9 km and The Trucker's Rest on the A5 at 18.7 km. Road distances will be longer. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Warley (11.5 km) and one at DY10 1JS (18.4 km) as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete, so there may be nearer options.

name: Wombwell
intro: In the Metropolitan Borough of Barnsley, Wombwell had a population of roughly 15,316 at the 2011 census once the Wombwell ward was added to small parts of the Darfield and Stairfoot wards, including Broomhill. Historically it was in the West Riding of Yorkshire, and its name may come from 'Womba's Well', meaning a well in a hollow. The town uses the S73 postcode district. Hoyland is about 3.4 km away, Wath upon Dearne 4.9 km, Barnsley 5.8 km and Cudworth and Shafton 7 km, with Swinton and Rawmarsh a little further. A driver dealing with an AdBlue warning has three service areas at a similar straight-line distance: Rotherham Services and Woolley Edge Services, both on the M1 at around 14.3 km to 14.5 km, and Barnsdale Bar on the A1 at 16 km.
roadsText: Rotherham Services on the M1 (14.3 km) and Woolley Edge Services, also on the M1 (14.5 km), are the nearest service areas to Wombwell in a straight line, with Barnsdale Bar Services on the A1 at 16 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station in Pontefract (WF7 7HX), about 14.4 km away, and another in Doncaster (DN4 0TP), about 15.7 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is patchy, so it is not a full list.

name: Woodbridge
intro: Thirteen kilometres up the River Deben from the sea, Woodbridge is a port town and civil parish in the East Suffolk district, 11 km north-east of Ipswich and around 119 km north-east of London. It is known for its boating harbour and tide mill next to the river, within the Suffolk & Essex Coast & Heaths National Landscape, and it is close to major Anglo-Saxon sites including the Sutton Hoo burial ship. The 2011 census recorded 7,749 people, and the town is covered by the IP12 postcode district. Kesgrave is the nearest neighbouring town at 6 km, followed by Ipswich at 11.8 km and Felixstowe at 14.9 km, with Harwich 18.4 km and Stowmarket 23.6 km away. For a van or diesel car based in Woodbridge, the nearest service area is 14 km away on the A14, so most local driving happens well away from any services.
roadsText: The nearest service area to Woodbridge is on the A14, 14 km from the town, with Beacon Hill on the A140 at 16.6 km. Further out, Ardleigh South on the A120 is 31.2 km away. None of these is in the town itself, so if an AdBlue warning comes on, those distances are worth bearing in mind before heading out on a longer journey.

name: Woodley
intro: Part of the Borough of Wokingham in Berkshire, Woodley is a town and civil parish 4 miles east of Reading. It adjoins Earley to the west, and the villages of Sonning, Twyford, Winnersh, Hurst and Charvil are all nearby. The area has a population of 28,019 and spans the RG5 and RG6 postcode districts. The M4 and A329(M) are both on the road list, along with the A4, A33, A329, A321, A3032 and A3290. Reading is 4.4km away, Caversham 5.3km and Wokingham 7.4km, with Henley-on-Thames at 9km. For a driver with a diesel van or car, that means a lot of short suburban journeys around the Reading area, with motorway links on hand for longer runs.
roadsText: Main roads listed around Woodley are the M4, A329(M), A33, A3290, A4, A329, A3032 and A321. Reading Services on the M4 is the nearest service area at 9.7km, followed by Fleet Services on the M3 (17.6km) and Beaconsfield Services on the M40 (24.4km). A station on the Swallowfield By-pass near Reading (RG7 1LZ), about 8.3km away, is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump. OpenStreetMap's data is incomplete.

name: Worcester
intro: Worcestershire's county town is Worcester, a cathedral city on the River Severn, 1.5 miles north of its confluence with the River Teme. It lies 30 miles (48km) south-west of Birmingham, 27 miles north of Gloucester and 23 miles north-east of Hereford, and had 103,872 residents at the 2021 census. The city is covered by the WR1 to WR5 postcode districts. Listed roads include the M5, A449, A44, A4440, A4103, A4538, A422 and A38. Droitwich Spa is about 8.2km away and Great Malvern 12.1km, with Stourport-on-Severn, Bromsgrove and Kidderminster between 17km and 21.3km off. That spread suggests a lot of driving between the city and nearby towns, plus M5 journeys. The nearest service area is about 15.7km away, so an AdBlue warning on a local trip may need a planned stop.
roadsText: Around Worcester the listed roads are the M5, A449, A44, A4440, A4103, A4538, A422 and A38. The nearest service area is Strensham services on the M5, about 15.7km away, followed by Hopwood Park services on the M42 at 25.8km and Frankley services on the M5 at 29km. OpenStreetMap lists a forecourt at DY10 1JS, about 19.5km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. That data is incomplete, so it should not be read as the only option.

name: Worcester Park and Stoneleigh
intro: Straddling the edge of south-west London and Surrey, Worcester Park lies partly in the London Borough of Sutton and partly in the Surrey borough of Epsom and Ewell, 10 miles (16 km) south-west of Charing Cross. Stoneleigh is one of its neighbouring localities, and together the two have a population of 15,851 across the KT4 and KT19 postcode districts. The Worcester Park post town matches the KT4 district and also extends into Old Malden. This is suburban driving, with other towns very close: Ewell is 2.9 km away, Kingston upon Thames 3.2 km and Epsom 4.6 km, while Sutton and Merton are both 5.6 km. With an AdBlue warning showing, the nearest listed service area is Cobham Services on the M25 at 13.1 km in a straight line, so motorway services are some way out of the suburb. A station at Catford, 18.9 km off, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Worcester Park and Stoneleigh are some distance from motorway services. Cobham Services on the M25 is nearest at 13.1 km in a straight line, Heston Services on the M4 is 16.1 km away and Wisley Services on the A3 is 18.6 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station at Catford, 18.9 km off, as selling AdBlue at the pump. The map is incomplete, so closer forecourts may sell it without being listed.

name: Workington
intro: Cumbria's west coast is home to Workington, a port town and civil parish in the Cumberland district at the mouth of the River Derwent. It lies 51 km south-west of Carlisle and 13 km north-east of Whitehaven. At the 2021 census the built-up area had 21,275 residents and the parish 25,448, and the town is in the CA14 postcode district. Of its neighbouring towns, only Whitehaven is close, at 11.2 km; Dumfries and Carlisle are both about 48 km off, and Penrith is 51.5 km. That distance matters for a diesel driver dealing with a dashboard warning, because the nearest motorway service areas are on the M6, 47.2 km or more away.
roadsText: Workington is a long way from motorway services: the nearest three are all on the M6, at Southwaite (47.2 km), Golden Fleece (49.8 km) and Todhills (50.5 km). Much closer, a station in Distington (CA14 4PJ), 4.1 km from the town, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump. That map data is incomplete, so other forecourts in the area may also sell it.

name: Worksop
intro: Close to Nottinghamshire's borders with South Yorkshire and Derbyshire, Worksop is a market town in Bassetlaw District on the River Ryton. It is not far from the northern edge of Sherwood Forest, with the area known as the Dukeries to the south. The 2021 census recorded 44,733 people in the town, and its postcode districts are S80 and S81. The A1 is among the main roads, along with the A57, A60, A619 and A620. Dinnington is about 9 km away and Retford 11.8 km, while Maltby is around 13.3 km and Shirebrook 13.7 km. Service areas on both the A1(M) and the M1 are within about 11 km of the town, giving a driver with an AdBlue warning options in more than one direction.
roadsText: The main roads listed for Worksop are the A1, A57, A60, A619 and A620. Moto Blyth Services on the A1(M) is the nearest service area at about 9.4 km, followed by Welcome Break Woodall Services on the M1 at 10.7 km and Markham Moor Services on the A1 at 14.5 km. A Tesco station about 19.9 km away is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump; that data is incomplete.

name: Worsley
intro: Along Worsley Brook, 6 miles (9.7 km) west of Manchester, Worsley is a village in the City of Salford with a population of 10,090 in 2014. It lies within the historic county boundaries of Lancashire. The completion of the Bridgewater Canal in 1761 turned it from a small village of cottage industries into an important town based on cotton manufacture, iron-working, brick-making and coal mining, and large urban estates were built after the two World Wars. Part of the historic centre is now a conservation area. The M28 postcode district covers Worsley. Walkden is only about 2 km away, and Swinton and Eccles both 2.5 km, with Little Hulton, Kearsley and Clifton between 3.6 km and 4.5 km. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, Birch Services on the M62 is the nearest motorway service area, about 12.4 km off.
roadsText: Birch Services on the M62 is the nearest service area to Worsley, about 12.4 km away. Rivington Services on the M61 is around 16.5 km off, and Lymm Services on the M6 about 18 km. OpenStreetMap has a station under Manchester, roughly 7.4 km away, listed as selling AdBlue at the pump, along with one under Warrington at 13.3 km and a site at 16 km. Those records are incomplete.

name: Worthing
intro: At the foot of the South Downs, 11 miles (18 km) west of Brighton and 18 miles (29 km) east of Chichester, Worthing is a seaside town and borough in West Sussex with a population of 113,094. It is the second largest component of the Brighton and Hove built-up area, while the northern parts of the borough fall within the South Downs National Park. Goring was incorporated into the town in 1929. Postcode districts include BN11 to BN16 and BN95. The A27, A24 and A259 are among the main roads listed for the area, and no motorway appears among them. Lancing and Sompting are 5.3 km away and Rustington 5.6 km. A driver with an AdBlue warning should note that the three listed service areas are all at least 17.6 km away, so none of them is in the town.
roadsText: Roads listed around Worthing are all A roads: the A27, A24, A280, A2032, A2031, A259 and A2025. The three nearest listed service areas sit at similar distances: Fontwell Services on the A27 at 17.6 km, Pyecombe Services on the A23 at 17.9 km and Buck Barn on the A24 at 18.6 km. A station about 19.5 km away is listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap; that data is incomplete, so there may be closer options.

name: Wrexham
intro: Wrexham lies between the Welsh mountains and the lower Dee Valley, close to the border with Cheshire in England, and is the largest built-up area in North Wales, with 44,785 people at the 2021 census. It was awarded city status in 2022 and has been the principal settlement and administrative centre of Wrexham County Borough since 1996; the wider county borough has 135,117 people. During the Industrial Revolution, Wrexham and the surrounding area was a major centre of coal and lead mining. Postcode districts across the city are LL11, LL12 and LL13. Rhosllannerchrugog is 6.7 km away, while Buckley, Hawarden and Chester are between 14.7 km and 16.7 km, with Oswestry at 22.1 km. For a van or diesel car, the city has three service areas within 8.5 km, all on A roads rather than motorways.
roadsText: Wrexham's main roads are the A483, A534, A5156, A5152, A525, A541 and A528. Several service areas are close by: Holt Road services on the A5156 is 2.1 km away, Rhostyllen services on the A483 is 4 km and Ruabon Park services on the A483 is 8.5 km. That gives drivers a choice of stops within a short distance of the city.

name: Wymondham
intro: Just off the A11 road to London, Wymondham is a South Norfolk market town on the River Tiffey, 10 miles (16 km) south-west of Norwich. Its parish is one of the largest in Norfolk, with rural areas to the north and south and hamlets including Suton, Silfield, Spooner Row and Wattlefield. The town has a population of 16,334 and is covered by the NR18 postcode district. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, Thickthorn Services on the A11 is 7.9 km away in a straight line, but beyond that the next listed service area is more than 47 km off. Attleborough is 9.3 km away and Norwich 13.7 km, with Taverham and Drayton at 14 km and Dereham at 16.5 km. Watton is 19.3 km from the centre.
roadsText: Wymondham lies just off the A11, and Thickthorn Services on that road is the nearest service area, 7.9 km from the centre in a straight line. The next two are much further: Beacon Hill Services on the A140 at 47.2 km and Freebridge Park on the A47 at 53 km. Thickthorn is the only listed service area within easy reach of NR18.

name: Wythenshawe
intro: Wythenshawe is an area of Manchester rather than a separate town. Historically part of Cheshire, it was transferred to the City of Manchester in 1931, after the city had begun building a large housing estate there in the 1920s. Covering about 11 square miles, it became the largest council estate in Europe. Its districts include Baguley, Benchill, Peel Hall, Newall Green, Woodhouse Park, Moss Nook, Northern Moor, Northenden and Sharston, so a Wythenshawe address could be in any of them. The postcode districts listed are M22, M23, M90 and WA15. The road list carries two motorways, the M56 and M60, along with the A560, A5103, A555, A34, A5145 and A538. Sale is 4.3 km away, Cheadle and Hale 4.4 km and Altrincham 4.9 km, with Cheadle Hulme and Stretford a little further.
roadsText: Wythenshawe's main roads include the M56 and M60, with the A560, A5103, A555, A34, A5145 and A538. The nearest service areas are on the M6: Tabley Hill and Knutsford Services, both 13.4 km away, and Lymm Services at 15.8 km. Stations listed as selling AdBlue at the pump in OpenStreetMap include one in Manchester's M25 postcode district (15.9 km), one about 16.2 km away and one in Warrington's WA3 (17 km). Coverage is incomplete.

name: Yate
intro: Chipping Sodbury, a market town to the east, runs straight into the built-up area of Yate, which spills into neighbouring parishes and has a population of just over 37,000. Yate itself is a South Gloucestershire town just south-west of the Cotswold Hills, 19 km north-east of Bristol and 19 km from Bath. It developed from a small village into a town from the 1950s onwards, and its parish had 23,701 people at the 2021 census. The BS37 postcode district covers the town. Frampton Cotterell and Winterbourne is 4.5 km away, Bradley Stoke 8.7 km and Thornbury 9.5 km, while Stoke Gifford, Kingswood and Fishponds and Patchway are between 9.3 km and 10.8 km. With the M4 among the main roads near the town, alongside the A46 and A432, a diesel van or car based here can reach the motorway network easily, though the nearest service area is still 12.5 km out.
roadsText: Yate's main roads are the M4, A46 and A432. The nearest service areas are Michaelwood on the M5, 12.5 km away, Severn View on the M48 at 15 km, and Leigh Delamere on the M4 at 18.8 km. All three are on motorways, so a stop on a longer run is straightforward, but each one involves a drive out of town first.

name: Yateley
intro: In the north-eastern corner of Hart District, Yateley is a Hampshire town and civil parish about 33 miles (53 km) south-west of central London. It includes the settlements of Frogmore and Darby Green to the east and recorded 20,334 people at the 2021 census. Its postcode district is GU46. Neighbouring towns are close: Sandhurst is 3.9 km away and Crowthorne 5 km, with Wokingham, Fleet, Farnborough and Camberley all between 6.5 km and 7.3 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the useful fact is that Fleet Services on the M3 is only 4.8 km away in a straight line. After that, the next listed service area, Reading Services on the M4, is 17 km off. A station on the Swallowfield By-pass near Reading, 12.4 km away, is listed in OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump.
roadsText: Fleet Services on the M3 is close to Yateley, 4.8 km away in a straight line. The other nearby service areas are much further out: Reading Services on the M4 at 17 km and Wisley Services on the A3 at 24.5 km. OpenStreetMap lists a station on the Swallowfield By-pass near Reading (RG7 1LZ), 12.4 km off, as selling AdBlue at the pump, though its records are incomplete.

name: Yeadon
intro: Leeds Bradford Airport sits immediately east of Yeadon, a town in the City of Leeds metropolitan borough in West Yorkshire. Most of the town is in the Otley and Yeadon ward, with a southern part, south of the A65, in the Guiseley and Rawdon ward, and it falls within the Leeds North West constituency. Yeadon has 14,273 residents and uses the LS19 postcode district. Guiseley is about 3 km away, Otley 4.7 km, Pudsey 7.3 km and Baildon 7.4 km, with Leeds itself 10.2 km. For a van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning, the nearest listed service area is Skelton Lake Service Station on the M1, about 16.7 km away in a straight line, and a station in Leeds listed on OpenStreetMap as selling AdBlue at the pump is the same distance.
roadsText: Part of Yeadon lies south of the A65. The nearest service areas in a straight line are Skelton Lake Service Station on the M1 (16.7 km), Hartshead Moor Services on the M62 (18 km) and Wetherby Services on the A1(M) (21.4 km). OpenStreetMap lists a station in Leeds (LS9 0AS), about 16.7 km away, as selling AdBlue at the pump. The map's AdBlue information is incomplete, so there may be other options.

name: Yeovil
intro: Aircraft and defence industries that developed in the 20th century are still major employers in Yeovil. The town lies close to Somerset's southern border with Dorset, 10 km west of Sherborne, 45 km east of Taunton and 68 km south of Bristol, and its built-up area had 50,170 people at the 2021 census, extending into the neighbouring parishes of Brympton, West Coker and Yeovil Without. Yeovil is on the A30 and A37 roads and has two railway stations. Postcode districts covering the area are BA20, BA21 and BA22. Apart from Sherborne, the nearest towns are some distance away, with Street at 21.2 km, Chard at 22.8 km and Bridport at 24.4 km, and Dorchester at 29.6 km. For vans and diesel cars, that means plenty of longer runs between towns, and the closest motorway services are more than 30 km away.
roadsText: Yeovil's main roads are the A30, A37, A3088 and A359. There are no motorway services nearby: the closest are on the M5, at Bridgwater (30.1 km), Taunton Deane (34.9 km) and Sedgemoor (41 km). That is a long way to go if a warning appears, so it is worth acting on it early rather than waiting for a motorway stop.

name: York
intro: Founded as Eboracum in AD 71, York is a cathedral city of Roman origins in North Yorkshire, at the confluence of the rivers Ouse and Foss, 27 miles (43 km) north-east of Leeds. Its built-up area had 141,685 residents at the 2021 census. The minster, castle and city walls are all Grade I listed, and the city is the traditional county town of Yorkshire and the administrative centre of the City of York district. For a driver with an AdBlue warning, the more practical facts are the roads and distances. No motorway appears among the main roads; instead the A64, A19, A59, A1079, A166, A1036, A1176 and A1237 are listed. Postcode districts include YO1, YO10, YO23, YO24, YO26, YO30, YO31 and YO32. Huntington, 4.1 km from the centre on a direct line, and Haxby, at 6.4 km, are the closest neighbouring places, while Selby is 19.7 km away and Wetherby 19.8 km.
roadsText: All of York's main roads are A roads: the A59, A19, A1079, A64, A1237, A166, A1036 and A1176. The nearest service area is Bilbrough Top on the A64, 8.5 km away on a direct line. Beyond that, Wetherby services on the A1(M) is 18.4 km away and Ferrybridge services on the M62 is 31.1 km. Distances by road will be longer than these figures.

name: Ystrad Mynach
intro: Before the Industrial Revolution and the coming of coal mining in the South Wales Coalfield, the Rhymney Valley around Ystrad Mynach was rural and farmed. The town is in Caerphilly County Borough, 5 miles (8.0 km) north of Caerphilly, within the ancient county of Glamorgan and the community of Gelligaer. The urban area had 19,204 people in 2011, and the CF82 postcode district covers it. Blackwood is 3.5 km away, followed by Pontypridd at 8.1 km and Risca at 8.5 km, with Church Village and Mountain Ash at 11 km and 11.2 km. If an AdBlue warning comes on here, bear in mind that the closest listed service area is on the M4, 14.1 km away in a straight line, and the next is 16.2 km off. Neither is close enough to treat as a quick detour.
roadsText: Ystrad Mynach's three nearest service areas are all on the M4. Cardiff Gate Services is 14.1 km away in a straight line, Cardiff West Services 16.2 km and Sarn Park Services 26.6 km. These are straight-line distances, so expect the road journey to be longer. A van or diesel car with an AdBlue warning in the Rhymney Valley has no service area close by, so it pays to plan the stop.
